GB.LHR.businessClassSummary:
For the discerning business class traveler seeking an unparalleled luxury London experience, the UK's vibrant capital promises a captivating blend of historic grandeur and contemporary sophistication. From the moment you depart on a Qatar Airways Business Class flight into London, prepare to immerse yourself in a world designed for ultimate comfort and exclusivity.

London's attractions extend far beyond conventional sightseeing for those accustomed to luxury travel. Consider a private viewing of the Crown Jewels at the Tower of London or an exclusive after-hours tour of the British Museum, avoiding the crowds. Experience the city from a unique perspective with a private helicopter tour offering panoramic vistas of iconic landmarks like the London Eye and Buckingham Palace.

London's fine dining scene is a gastronomic paradise. A number of Michelin-starred establishments offer exquisite culinary journeys. Mayfair and Marylebone are havens for gourmet restaurants, promising exceptional cuisine and extensive wine lists. Whether you seek innovative Modern British cuisine, authentic French gastronomy, or refined Asian fusion, London's exclusive dining options cater to every discerning palate, ensuring a memorable culinary experience.

For the ultimate luxury shopping experience, London reigns supreme. Bond Street, Europe's most expensive shopping street, is home to flagship boutiques of global luxury brands, offering high-end fashion, designer jewelry, and exclusive accessories. Explore the iconic Harrods in Knightsbridge for an unparalleled selection of premium goods and personal shopping services. London offers endless opportunities for the most discerning luxury shoppers. Many establishments provide VIP services and private appointments for a truly exclusive retail journey.
GB.LHR.touristAttractionsText:
Kick off your London adventure with a dose of royal pomp at Buckingham Palace. Grab a prime spot outside the gates and prepare to be impressed by the Changing of the Guard ceremony – a truly British experience that can’t be missed.

Journey back in time to the heart of medieval Britain at the Tower of London. The incredible architecture and array of Crown Jewels displayed inside will leave you dazzled. Take a stroll along the River Thames to catch Big Ben chime.

Enjoy more history at the British Museum which houses a treasure trove of artefacts spanning thousands of years. For some prehistoric discoveries, make sure to drop by the Natural History Museum where you can witness gigantic dinosaur fossils and hands-on exhibits.
GB.LHR.leisureActivitiesText:
London is a kaleidoscope of experiences, all within easy reach. Embrace nature in the heart of the city with a stroll through Hyde Park. This flourishing oasis offers the perfect escape from the urban hustle and bustle. You can enjoy a picnic on a sunny day by the Serpentine or cosy up with a warm drink during the morning chill. 

Soar above the city and witness its grandeur from the London Eye, the world’s fourth largest Ferris wheel. If you're not fond of heights, opt for a unique view of London’s skyline from the water on a leisurely cruise down the River Thames. 

A trip to London is not complete without an evening in London’s West End. Dotted with some of the most historic theatres, it’s the place to be to experience a world-class theatrical performance.
GB.LHR.shoppingText:
Known as one of the best shopping destinations in the world, London is home to luxury boutiques, quirky markets and everything in between.   

Oxford Street is the area to be for designer labels and high-end goods. The lively street itself is a landmark, with its unique juxtaposition of quaint and modern buildings side by side. It is particularly picturesque during the festive season when lights line the street and turn it into a winter wonderland.  

For an eclectic shopping experience, explore the colourful streets of Notting Hill, popular for its boutiques, book shops and street vendors. The elegant Regent Street also boasts a diverse range of retailers that cater to every taste and budget.

Other must-see shopping hotspots include Carnaby Street, St James, Bond Street, Mayfair, Covent Garden and Knightsbridge.
GB.LHR.destinationPageIntro: Book a flight to London and experience a dynamic city, bursting with history and plenty to do and see – from palaces, museums, and art galleries, to public parks and popular markets.
GB.LHR.overviewText:
Unleash your inner explorer in majestic London. This sprawling metropolis pulsates with culture and vibrant street life, while boasting centuries-old architectural gems.

Home to some of the world’s most iconic landmarks, London isn’t short on things to see and do. Whether you’re into culture or a quintessential afternoon tea enthusiast, London’s eclectic energy will steal your heart. 

Winter’s frosted charm or summer’s lively buzz? Whatever the weather, it’s always a good time to visit London.
GB.LHR.eatingImageText:
For a truly local experience, cosy up in a local eatery and indulge in a hearty Sunday roast – traditionally made up of roasted meat, crispy roast potatoes and veggies, Yorkshire pudding and gravy. And for something a little more on the go, try fish and chips often served with a side of mushy peas. 

Explore Borough Market, one of London’s oldest and largest food markets with over 100 delicatessens, butchers, fishmongers and cheesemakers.   

For lovers of artisan food and international cuisine, scout Camden Market and Brick Lane to taste authentic Indian curry or delectable dim sum.   

Interested in luxury dining? Be spoilt for choice with over 80 Michelin-starred restaurants scattered across the city boasting world-class flavours.

QA.DOH.businessClassSummary:
Fly to Doha in Business and First Class with Qatar Airways and indulge in unmatched luxury. From the moment you arrive, our world-class team ensures that every detail of your journey is one to remember.

Your Business and First Class experience begins in our elegant Business Class lounges, where you can unwind in a private space, take a shower to freshen up, or sip on a complimentary drink. Once you step on board, your journey reaches new heights of comfort. Our state-of-the-art fleet features spacious cabins, offering generous legroom and ambient lighting to help you adjust naturally to your destination’s time zone.

To satisfy your palate, savour a delicious meal from our on-demand à la carte menu, prepared by our award-winning chefs. Then, sit back and browse thousands of entertainment options, or recline in a lie-flat bed and drift into a restful sleep. Wherever you’re going, stay connected throughout your flight with high-speed Wi-Fi on our A380, A350, B787 and select B777 aircraft.

For an unrivalled travel experience, book your First Class or Business Class flight to Doha with Qatar Airways today.
QA.DOH.touristAttractionsText:
Qatar’s museums offer a captivating glimpse into its rich history and heritage. Embark on a cultural journey through the Museum of Islamic Art and discover the creative genius of artistic visionaries at the National Museum of Qatar. 

Katara Cultural Village is another local gem, where art and culture come to life through a thriving hub of theatres, concert halls and galleries. This vibrant locale beautifully captures the essence of Qatar’s heritage with its unique architecture and traditional ambience.

Long for a day in the great outdoors? Journey to the Inland Sea, one of the few places in the world where seawater merges into the desert. This environmental spectacle boasts the marvellous views of rugged ridges, heightened plateaus and salt hillocks.
QA.DOH.leisureActivitiesText:
Take a stroll along the Corniche to behold West Bay’s skyscrapers gleaming in the sunlight or hop onto a dhow boat ride along the tranquil waters. 

While you’re in the area, make sure to stop by the man-made island ‘The Pearl’ located right off the coast of Doha. It is home to luxurious hotels, high-end boutiques and beautiful beaches. It also features a marina promenade perfect for leisurely strolls and lined with a variety of restaurants and cafés. 

If you crave a more thrilling adventure, try knee-boarding, jet skiing or parasailing at Katara Beach. You can also take up an action-packed desert safari tour or kayak through the aquatic channels of Al Thakira Beach. Discover Qatar offers an impressive range of tours and services to plan your trip.
QA.DOH.shoppingText:
Shop to your heart’s content. Doha is renowned for its expansive malls, family-friendly shopping centres and luxury boutiques. With world-leading brands at every corner, you can count on finding the perfect gifts for your loved ones – or yourself. 

For an authentic Arabian shopping experience, head to any of the popular souqs and bazaars. Browse through the bustling alleys of Souq Waqif, where you can pick up a memento of your trip to Doha while admiring the souq’s authentic vibe. 

For a shopping experience that is unique to Qatar, check out the Falcon Souq. This is a fascinating place that exemplifies a bespoke aspect of the country’s heritage.
QA.DOH.destinationPageIntro: Discover the heart of Qatar, a desert oasis like no other. Dune bash through the desert to the Inland Sea, explore the Qatar National Museum, or indulge at a luxury resort.
QA.DOH.overviewText:
Doha is a vibrant desert oasis that sits along the Arabian Gulf amidst the rolling dunes of the desert. Its skyline boasts futuristic skyscrapers contrasted against historic mosques and souqs.

Venture on an exhilarating outdoor adventure, stay in awe-inspiring resorts or wander through bustling souqs for a mesmerising cultural experience. Whatever your passions and interests are, Doha is sure to capture your heart with its enchanting blend of tradition and modernity. 

Qatar warmly welcomes visitors from around the world. Visitors from 102 countries can enter visa-free. Find more information here.
QA.DOH.destinationHighlightsH1: Doha: The beating heart of Qatar
QA.DOH.eatingImageText:
Indulge in cuisine whipped up by the globe’s finest chefs, boasting a selection of international flavours from Turkish and Indian to Mediterranean and much more.

Make your way to Souq Waqif for a taste of Qatari cuisine. Be sure to sample the much-loved sweet and savoury breakfast dish, balaleet, and the traditional dinner, machboos, made with aromatic spices, meat and rice. Seafood is also a key ingredient in local dishes. Enjoy the catch of the day served at restaurants overlooking the harbour at the Mina District. 

Relax with a steaming hot cup of karak tea and if you need a bite on the go, head to your closest shawarma shop for one of the region’s favourite snacks.

US.JFK.overviewTabHeading: Book your visit to New York City
US.JFK.businessClassSummary:
Book a flight to New York in Business or First Class with Qatar Airways and arrive in the Big Apple in supreme comfort. From the moment you check in to the moment you land, you’re looked after by a world-renowned team committed to making every aspect of your journey flawless.

Begin with frictionless check-in at a dedicated counter, before making your way to one of our elegant Business Class lounges. Freshen up by taking a hot shower or sipping on a cool beverage while you wait to board. You can also find a quiet spot to sit back and relax with good a book, or catch up on your emails undisturbed. 

Once your flight is called, you’re welcomed on board our state-of-the-art aircraft by professional and courteous cabin crew. Your ergonomically designed seat awaits, with plenty of extra legroom for you to stretch out. During the flight, join a video meeting without dropouts or buffering, thanks to high-speed Wi-Fi available on our A380, A350, B787 and select B777 aircraft. 

Then explore the flavours of our enticing menu, tempting you with cuisine freshly prepared by our chefs. Afterwards, watch the latest Hollywood film, TV show, or play a game or two. To arrive feeling refreshed, get a restful sleep on one of our lie-flat beds, while the ambient lighting adjusts to match your destination’s time zone.  

Fly to New York in Business or First Class with Qatar Airways – the most luxurious way to travel.
US.JFK.touristAttractionsText:
Begin your adventure atop the iconic Empire State Building, the most celebrated structure in the city’s skyline. While you’re in the area, stop by Rockefeller Center, a must-see spot. Visiting during the holidays? Then you’re in luck – this bustling hub transforms into a winter wonderland.

No trip to New York is complete without a visit to Times Square, where the city’s vibrant energy is on full display with neon lights, Broadway theatres and endless entertainment. 

If art and culture is on your bucket list, visit New York’s Museum Mile – a strip along 5th Avenue on the Upper East Side. Browse the Metropolitan Museum of Art (The MET) or admire Guggenheim’s spiral architecture. Alternatively, explore Central Park and pop by the American Museum of Natural History.
US.JFK.leisureActivitiesText:
You haven’t been to NYC if you haven’t seen the Statue of Liberty. Hop on a Staten Island ferry ride across the harbour (or do a sightseeing cruise) to sail right past it and take some snapshots.

A walk across Brooklyn Bridge is also a classic New York experience. Trek to DUMBO and spend the day exploring the trendy atmosphere this neighbourhood is known for.

Central Park is a must-see no matter the season – go rowing at its serene lake in summer or ice-skating on the rink in winter. This outdoor venue boasts celebrations all year round, from exciting summer concerts to enchanting holiday markets.

For a fun night out, be sure to catch a Broadway show at the Theatre District, which is filled with world-class performances.
US.JFK.businessClassTitle: Business Class flights to New York
US.JFK.shoppingText:
New York has earned its reputation as one of the best shopping destinations in the world, offering a diverse collection that caters to every style. Start your retail adventure on the renowned 5th Avenue, where luxury boutiques and flagship stores line the streets.

Head to SoHo for its bespoke boutiques, contemporary art galleries and fashion-forward stores. You will find internationally renowned fashion and beauty brands mixed with small, locally owned establishments filled with creative wares. In contrast to SoHo, Williamsburg and Bushwick in Brooklyn are treasure troves for vintage and thrift shopping.
US.JFK.touristAttractionsTabHeading: Things to do in New York City
US.JFK.destinationPageIntro: New York is full of landmarks, museums and eateries. The city that never sleeps has an infectious energy that will fill your itinerary, from the Brooklyn Bridge to 5th Avenue.
US.JFK.overviewText:
Famously known as the ‘city that never sleeps’, New York City is just that – a bustling metropolis that offers an array of unique experiences for every traveller.

When you think of New York City, a set of symbols instantly come to mind – Central Park, the Statue of Liberty, Times Square, Brooklyn Bridge…the list can go on and on. With its iconic skyline, world-class museums, vibrant theatres and diverse culinary scene, there’s always something to see and do. New York City will surely captivate you with its infectious energy and endless charm.
US.JFK.socialProofQuote: Book flights to New York City (JFK)
US.JFK.destinationHighlightsH1: New York City: The Big Apple
US.JFK.eatingImageText:
The culinary scene in New York City delights food enthusiasts from around the world. For a classic New York experience, stop by one of the speakeasies. These camouflaged establishments have one-of-a-kind offerings in a hidden setting.

Continue your gastronomic journey at Chelsea Market, a bustling hall of gourmet foods, fresh produce and artisanal goods. Roam through Little Italy, where authentic Italian eateries serve up traditional dishes from freshly made pasta to crunchy cannoli. Uncover the hidden gems of Chinatown and the Lower East Side, where hole-in-the-wall restaurants offer delicious, original meals.

Craving a taste of upscale dining? Venture to SoHo for a sophisticated meal in a fashionable setting.

JP.HND.businessClassSummary:
Fly to Tokyo in Business or First Class with Qatar Airways and travel to Japan’s vibrant capital in unmatched comfort. At the start of your journey, enjoy smooth check-in at a dedicated counter, so you have more time to unwind in one of our Business Class lounges. Take a refreshing shower, sample a range of delightful snacks, or relax in private areas before your flight.

Once on board, settle into your spacious seat with generous legroom, featuring an ergonomic design. Ambient lighting helps your body to adapt to your destination’s time zone, while high-speed Wi-Fi on our A380, A350, B787 and select B777 aircraft, lets you stay in touch with colleagues or loved ones. Browse thousands of options, from films to TV shows and games – all available on our advanced in-flight entertainment system.

Then indulge in gourmet cuisine from our à la carte menu, carefully prepared by award-winning chefs and served whenever you choose. When it’s time to sleep, recline in a lie-flat bed for a peaceful rest. Pamper yourself with a sophisticated amenity kit, and you’ll land at your destination feeling refreshed and ready to explore a dynamic blend of tradition and innovation. 

Book a Business or First Class flight to Tokyo with Qatar Airways, and begin your Japanese adventure in unparalleled luxury.
JP.HND.touristAttractionsText:
Visit Tokyo’s oldest temple, Sensō-ji. Walk through the grand Kaminarimon Gate where the scents and sights take you back in time. Explore the adjoining Nakamise Street for unique souvenirs and local snacks.

Soak in the city’s skyline from the top of the Tokyo Skytree, an architectural marvel. Alternatively, head to the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building’s observatory in Shinjuku, where entry is complimentary. A short metro ride away is Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden. The largest park in the city, it offers an oasis of tranquillity with its green space. Visit in the spring for cherry blossoms, famously known as sakura. 

Take a glimpse into Tokyo’s history at the Imperial Place. Officially the residence of the Emperor of Japan, you can explore its parks and admire the ancient moats.
JP.HND.leisureActivitiesText:
Embrace the local way of life at Yoyogi Park. Featuring wide lawns, ponds and forested areas, it’s perfect for jogging, picnics and various outdoor activities. 

Step into the world of avant-garde style art at the Yayoi Kusama Museum. Immerse yourself in a euphoric experience with polka dots, pumpkins and infinity rooms. The bold and eccentric creations of Japan’s most famous contemporary artist will leave you in awe.

For something authentic yet thrilling, attend a sumo wrestling tournament – one of Japan’s oldest and most revered sports. Usually held six times a year, three take place in Tokyo in January, May and September. 

A unique way to explore Tokyo is by go-kart. Dress up in your favourite character costume and drive through the city as if you’re in a real-life video game.
JP.HND.shoppingText:
Begin your shopping at one of the many department stores in Shinjuku. Explore luxury brands and amazing made-in-Japan goods to bring home with you. 

Enjoy treasure hunting at the Oedo Antique Market. Located at the Tokyo International Forum, it’s a vibrant outdoor bazaar held on the first and third Sunday of every month. From antique samurai swords to vintage kimonos, you’re sure to find a unique souvenir.

If you love anime and manga, Nakano Broadway is not to be missed. It’s a must-visit for collectors and pop culture lovers, brimming with rare manga, action figures and memorabilia.

Inclined to enjoy laidback second-hand shopping? Head to the boho district of Shimokitazawa. The narrow streets are lined with vintage stores, offering everything from retro clothes to one-of-a-kind accessories.
JP.HND.destinationPageIntro: Fly to Haneda Airport, located close to Tokyo. Experience this buzzing metropolis where tradition intertwines with modern cityscapes, a recipe for the perfect adventure.
JP.HND.overviewText:
Fly to the futuristic and eclectic capital of Japan, via Haneda Airport located close to Tokyo city. The busy streets are alive with neon lights, modern buildings and eye-catching shopfronts stocked with unique Japanese innovation. In the midst of the hustle and bustle are the traditional parts of town, filled with street markets and ornate buildings.

Eat your way through the city or explore Tokyo’s exciting shopping and art scene. The changing seasons bring beauty and a charming atmosphere – from the soft pink hues of cherry blossoms in the spring to the rich amber colours of autumn leaves. Whether you are drawn to the city’s electric vibe, its culinary wonders, or rich traditions woven into daily life – Tokyo is a city that will leave you captivated.
JP.HND.destinationHighlightsH1: Tokyo: Unveiling tradition in a futuristic metropolis
JP.HND.eatingImageText:
Sample amazing sushi at the Tsukiji Outer Market. Freshly caught fish and seafood ensures the enjoyment of the best flavours and quality. Other amazing street foods are also available – fluffy Japanese omelette (tamagoyaki), ramen and locally grown fruits. 

Near the West Exit of Shinjuku Station, Omoide Yokocho exudes the nostalgia of old, Show-era Japan. Its tiny eateries are known for piping hot oden (a type of Japanese one-pot dish) and yakitori (grilled chicken skewers).

Craving something sweet? Stroll down Harmonica Yokocho in Kichijoji. It’s a maze of small restaurants and snack shops serving local sweets. Popular choices include chewy mochi (rice cakes) and fish-shaped pastry called taiyaki.

For foodie-related souvenirs, go to Kappabashi Street where you can find intricately designed chopsticks, kitchen tools and more.

FR.CDG.businessClassSummary:
Europe's most romantic city awaits when you book Business or First Class flights to Paris with Qatar Airways. Whether you're visiting the French capital for business or pleasure, get off to the best start with Qatar Airways' premium service.

Your journey begins in one of our Business Class lounges, where you can freshen up with an invigorating shower, sip a revitalising drink, or find a quiet spot to catch up on your emails. When your aircraft is ready, our world-renowned team will show you to your spacious seat and look after your every need to ensure unmatched comfort. 

During your flight, you can choose a delicious meal from our à la carte menu, prepared by our award-winning chefs. Then sit back and enjoy our selection of in-flight entertainment, or make the most of the fast, complimentary Wi-Fi onboard our A380, A350, B787 and select B777 aircraft. Take a well-deserved rest in a lie-flat bed, and let ambient lighting reset your internal clock to your destination time zone. Arrive refreshed and ready to embrace life in the ‘City of Love’. 

Book Business or First Class flights to Paris with Qatar Airways today and experience ultimate luxury.
FR.CDG.touristAttractionsText:
There is no shortage of attractions to visit in Paris. Naturally, you must begin your Parisian journey at the iconic Eiffel Tower on the Left Bank, where panoramic views of the city provide a breathtaking introduction to the city of Paris. Nearby, the Louvre Museum beckons with its vast collection of art and history, including the masterpiece – Mona Lisa.

Just across the Seine, the Musée d’Orsay awaits, housing an array of Impressionist and Post-Impressionist artworks. A picturesque walk along the river will take you to the majestic Notre-Dame Cathedral which offers a look into Paris’ medieval past.

Stroll down the famous Champs-Élysées and marvel at the Arc de Triomphe. This historic arch honours those who fought for France during the French Revolution and Napoleonic Wars, and provides another lookout point for you to enjoy.
FR.CDG.leisureActivitiesText:
Set sail on the Seine and cruise past the city’s landmarks, with a pleasant vantage point from the water that presents an idyllic setting for couples.

Explore the artistic haven of Montmartre, with its cobblestone streets and quaint cafés that inspired the likes of Picasso and Van Gogh. Visit the Sacré-Cœur Basilica and immerse yourself in the energetic atmosphere of Place du Tertre. For a relaxing afternoon, roam the Luxembourg Gardens, an ideal spot to soak in the Parisian ambiance.

Take a short train ride to the opulent Palace of Versailles, a UNESCO World Heritage site that is a testament to France’s elaborate history. Last but not least, families can thoroughly cherish time at a whimsical theme park for a once-in-a-lifetime adventure just outside the city.
FR.CDG.shoppingText:
Paris is the fashion capital of the world, granting shoppers an experience that blends luxury, tradition and innovation. From modern malls to luxurious boutique-lined streets and traditional markets, shopping in Paris is an attraction in itself.

For an exclusive shopping trip, venture between the Arc de Triomphe and the Franklin D. Roosevelt Metro Station along the Champs-Élysées. This renowned avenue is part of the prestigious Golden Triangle and is dotted with flagship stores of haute couture, designer brands, affluent boutiques and charming cafés.

Choose from a branded handbag, stylish garments or a custom fragrance to take home your own piece of Parisian class.
FR.CDG.destinationPageIntro: Be captivated by the City of Light and discover the wonders of Paris. Marvel at art, indulge in buttery croissants, sip on café du laits and wander the dreamy streets.
FR.CDG.overviewText:
Paris is a timeless destination that will captivate you with its rich heritage, stunning architecture, and unparalleled cultural offerings. The charm of Paris lies not only in its monuments but also in its vibrant neighbourhoods. The cobbled streets of Montmartre, the charm of the Left Bank, and the lavish boutiques of Champs-Élysées each offer a unique glimpse into the beauty of this European city.

Whether marveling at art, savouring a delectable croissant at a sidewalk café or simply wandering the romantic streets, Paris promises an enchanting experience for travellers of every kind.
FR.CDG.destinationHighlightsH1: Paris: A city of romance and elegance
FR.CDG.eatingImageText:
Start your gastronomic expedition in Paris at the Marché des Enfants Rouges, the oldest food market in Paris that has been open since 1615. For a truly French experience, discover the upscale district of Saint-Germain-des-Prés to indulge in fine charcuterie and French cheeses.

It goes without saying that you must spend your mornings enjoying a buttery croissant from a local patisserie, paired with a café au lait.

For a taste of heartier fare, enjoy the classic French dish steak frites – steak with French fries, or French onion soup – a savoury broth of caramelised onions topped with melted cheese, served with a baguette. Escargots (snails) are another popular dish, prepared with garlic and parsley butter. When it’s time for dessert, indulge in some macarons – perfectly crafted sweets notable to Paris.

AE.DXB.businessClassSummary:
Your premium travel experience awaits when booking Business or First Class flights to Dubai with Qatar Airways. Thanks to a world-class team and state-of-the-art aircraft, every moment will be unforgettable. 

Begin your journey at a relaxed pace in one of our refined Business Class lounges. Here, you can find a quiet spot to read, check your emails, or even take a hot shower. When your aircraft is ready, our welcoming team will show you to your spacious seat, where you can stretch out in complete comfort thanks to generous legroom. The cabin is quiet and tranquil, with ambient lighting to help you adjust to your destination’s time zone easily.  

Our à la carte menu is prepared daily, with superior quality dishes crafted by our award-winning chefs. After enjoying your meal, sit back and choose from a wide variety of in-flight entertainment options, or use our high-speed Wi-Fi to catch up on work. Lie-flat beds are perfect for a nap before you land, refreshed and ready to experience one of the most glamorous cities on earth.  

Book flights to Dubai with Qatar Airways and embrace the most luxurious way to travel.
AE.DXB.touristAttractionsText:
Start your journey at the world’s tallest building, the Burj Khalifa, where ascending its peak will reward you with stunning views of the city. If you are brave enough, walk onto the outdoor observation deck. Stroll around the base of this towering marvel and explore the vast shopping and entertainment precincts. The fountain show outside is a must-see – it will captivate you with its rhythmic water display.

For a different kind of enchantment, visit the Dubai Miracle Garden, home to majestic floral sculptures. Or head to Palm Jumeirah, a man-made island shaped like a palm tree, dotted with luxurious resorts and world-class restaurants.

If you are travelling with children, pay a visit to the Green Planet, an indoor rainforest filled with lush vegetation and exotic wildlife.
AE.DXB.leisureActivitiesText:
Dubai’s recreational pursuits cater to all seasons. In summer, why not hit the slopes at Ski Dubai? This indoor snow park offers the opportunity to ski, toboggan and tube. In the winter months, take advantage of the mild temperatures by relaxing on Kite Beach or hiring a jet ski – both will allow you to take in beautiful views from the water.

For a taste of culture, Dubai has no shortage of interesting museums. The Museum of the Future is a design wonder and allows you to journey through possible futures in an interactive environment.

No trip to the Middle East is complete without a desert safari. Take a day to tour the Arabian Desert where you can try your hand at camel riding and dune bashing. Savour an authentic barbecue dinner as you watch the sun set behind the golden dunes.
AE.DXB.shoppingText:
Dubai has everything to offer on the retail spectrum, from traditional handicrafts to high-end handbags.

The city’s megamalls are worth a visit. Not only do they house superb shopping outlets, but some also offer theme parks and aquariums. 

Spend an evening in Dubai’s Old Town – a window into the day-to-day life of the city’s locals, providing excellent shopping opportunities for souvenirs. Shop for 18k and 24k gold at the gold souk; perfumes and textiles at the traditional souk; and zaatar at the spice souk. You’ll also find artisanal, handmade products such as wooden camel figures, silk scarves, cashmere blankets and intricately designed tableware.
AE.DXB.destinationPageIntro: Get to know the contrasting culture of the UAE by visiting the futuristic Burj Khalifa and then the traditional Gold Souq.
AE.DXB.overviewText:
Dubai offers many unforgettable experiences and sights, from modern architectural marvels to adventure-filled activities. Known for its futuristic skyline and affluent lifestyle, it’s where the who’s who from the world gather to shop, play and dine in style.

Immerse yourself in the decadence of opulent malls and five-star hotels. Admire the impressive attractions and enjoy the sun-soaked beaches. Or travel to the desert to discover the beauty of the natural landscape of the United Arab Emirates.

Dubai is bursting with activities for all seasons – this progressive city has something to entice every kind of traveller.
AE.DXB.destinationHighlightsH1: Dubai: The dazzling heart of the UAE
AE.DXB.eatingImageText:
Food lovers will appreciate Dubai’s culinary diversity. Dine at world-renowned restaurants and indulge in Michelin-star fare.

For an international gastronomical feast, spend an evening roaming Global Village. Sample your way through the Japanese street markets, wander between the Thai boat stalls or feel like a kid again when ordering a Turkish ice cream.

When it’s time for a taste of the real Dubai, try a local shawarma from one of the stalls scattered across the city. Try other delectable Arabic food like falafel, mixed mezze and majboos, a traditional dish of spiced rice and chicken.

Find a date market to learn about the harvesting and production process of UAE’s favourite fruit, and make sure you purchase a few to devour too.

SG.SIN.businessClassSummary:
Fly to Singapore in Business or First Class with Qatar Airways to reach one of the world’s most dynamic destinations in sheer style. Arrive ready to do business or begin your vacation after a luxurious flight, where your every need is taken care of by our world-renowned team. 

Begin with effortless check-in before relaxing in one of our exclusive Business Class lounges. Here, you can take a shower to freshen up, check your emails, or read a magazine while sipping a cool drink. When you board our state-of-the-art aircraft, you’ll be greeted by our exceptional cabin crew. They’re there to look after you and make sure your journey is one to remember. 

Unwind in your spacious seat, ergonomically designed for maximum comfort with extra legroom. You can also catch up on some work by connecting to the high-speed Wi-Fi, available on our A380, A350, B787 and select B777 aircraft, or enjoy a movie from our extensive entertainment selection. Then indulge in a mouth-watering meal, freshly prepared by our award-winning chefs, followed by a restful sleep in a lie-flat bed.

Book a Business or First Class flight to Singapore with Qatar Airways for an exceptional travel experience.
SG.SIN.touristAttractionsText:
Singapore is a dynamic city that boasts many well-known tourist attractions. Marvel at the futuristic design of Marina Bay Sands and soak in the views from the SkyPark Observation Deck. Check out the flora and unique displays at Gardens by the Bay, where the renowned Supertree Grove steals the show.

For a taste of Singapore’s multicultural charm, visit Kampong Glam, the Muslim quarter of the city, along with Little India and Chinatown.

If you’re a thrill-seeker or have children, enjoy a day trip to Sentosa Island. With a theme park and stunning palm-lined beaches – it’s a fantastic recreational destination.

A holiday to Singapore would not be complete without a glimpse of the Merlion in Merlion Park – a half-lion half-fish creature that is the mascot of Singapore.
SG.SIN.leisureActivitiesText:
If you are inclined to slow down on holiday, take a leisurely stroll through the iconic Singapore Botanic Gardens. Listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, it is known for its rich variety of tropical flora, stunning lakes and tranquil setting.

To view Singapore from the water, sit back and relax on a boat tour down the Singapore River. Some tours are in amphibious cars which include sightseeing on the road before the vehicle converts into a boat for the rest of the journey.

Immerse yourself in the timeless elegance of one of Singapore’s renowned heritage hotels, some dating as far back as the 19th century. Here, you’ll get a taste of luxury, service and style from a bygone era.

For something special and offbeat, explore Haw Par Villa. This park is abundant with quirky and bizarre sculptures that celebrates Chinese folklore and mythology.
SG.SIN.shoppingText:
Shopping in Singapore is an activity as diverse and vibrant as the city itself, with all kinds of establishments from high-end shops to bustling street markets. A shopper’s haven, discover international department stores and designer boutiques to spend your remaining Singapore Dollars. Some of the malls are also architectural marvels or ultramodern activity centres with attractions to enjoy when the weather is too humid.

For one-of-a-kind souvenirs or handcrafted goods, make your way to Bugis Street, Chinatown and Haji Lane in Kampong Glam. Browse textiles, traditional clothing, beadwork and tasty treats such as Chinese kueh (traditional cakes). Or bring home a miniature Merlion to remember your Singaporean adventure.
SG.SIN.destinationPageIntro: A true urban oasis, Singapore is renowned for its cleanliness, multicultural cuisine, modern architecture and futuristic parks.
SG.SIN.overviewText:
Singapore is a city that defies description with its impeccable parks, futuristic skyline and lively ambience. Home to a large variety of cultures, it’s become synonymous with being one of the most diverse, modern and green cities in Asia. Amidst its modernity lies a tapestry of tradition showcased through lush gardens, historic temples and ornate architecture.

Explore luxurious and surreal landmarks, indulge in world-class shopping, and devour incredible local and international dishes. With such a unique blend of attractions, Singapore offers an unforgettable experience.
SG.SIN.eatingImageText:
Singapore is a culinary wonderland, brimming with restaurants, cafés and markets. Embrace multicultural cuisine, with food from various nations and establishments aplenty.

For an authentic dining experience, head to the hawker centres. Hong Lim in Chinatown is a popular choice for an exceptional selection of dishes, snacks and extraordinary beverages. Do not miss Maxwell Food Centre, where you can feast on a variety of local delights, from fluffy tapioca cake to tasty dim sum. The options are endless.

Start your day with a Singaporean breakfast of kaya toast (toast with butter and coconut jam) and kopi (coffee). End it with a plate of Singapore chilli crab – a well-known dish synonymous with the city’s gastronomic heritage.

AU.SYD.businessClassSummary:
Fly to Sydney in Business or First Class with Qatar Airways and make your journey as memorable as the destination. From arrival at the airport to landing at your destination, our world-renowned team ensures that you experience unmatched comfort. 

Enjoy priority check-in and a quick route through immigration, then spend time in one of our Business Class lounges. Here, you can savour freshly prepared light meals and beverages, use the workstations, or take an invigorating shower before your flight. 

Once on board, sit back in your ergonomically designed seat with plenty of personal space to unwind. Ambient lighting helps you adjust naturally to your destination’s time zone, while high-speed Wi-Fi (available on our A380, A350, B787 and select B777 aircraft) keeps you connected to colleagues and loved ones.  

At any point during your flight, you can feast on gourmet cuisine from our à la carte menu, prepared by our award-winning chefs. After your meal, explore a wide range of entertainment options from films and TV shows to games. When it’s time to sleep, transform your seat into a fully lie-flat bed for a soothing, uninterrupted rest. You’ll feel refreshed and ready to explore thriving business hubs, coastal scenery and the exciting arts scene of Australia’s iconic city.    

Book a flight to Sydney in Business or First Class with Qatar Airways and indulge in unparalleled luxury.
AU.SYD.touristAttractionsText:
Begin your sightseeing at the Sydney Opera House, where you can catch a show inside or admire its architectural splendour from the outside. After your visit, take a leisurely stroll around Circular Quay to enjoy the stunning views of the famous harbour.

For an adrenaline rush, climb the Sydney Harbour Bridge for unparalleled vistas. If you prefer a relaxed approach, cycle or walk over this famous structure.

Sydney also boasts many museums and galleries. Peruse the varied exhibitions and installations at the Art Gallery of New South Wales and visit the nation’s first museum, the Australian Museum, which showcases Aboriginal and other significant cultural objects.

Continue your cultural tour with a walk through The Rocks – its cobblestone streets and heritage-listed buildings offer a glimpse into Sydney’s history.
AU.SYD.leisureActivitiesText:
Sydney offers a diverse array of activities for adventure seekers and city lovers alike. Take a scenic coastal walk from Coogee to Bondi Beach for the quintessential Australian seaside experience. Head to the public pool for some laps or the beach to catch some waves.

To continue the marine theme, hop on a ferry over to Manly where you can unwind on its golden beaches. If you’re there on a Saturday or Sunday, there’s a weekend market worth checking out.

After soaking up the sun and surf, immerse yourself in Sydney’s lush green spaces. Discover the serene beauty of the Royal Botanical Gardens or pack a picnic for Centennial Park – a peaceful oasis in the middle of the city. Go beyond the city limits to the second oldest national park on the planet, the Royal National Park, or hike the spectacular Blue Mountains.
AU.SYD.shoppingText:
Whether you’re looking for bohemian beachwear or designer labels, Sydney’s shopping spots have got you covered.

Find some of the best local and international designers in Double Bay, where chic stores stock the latest trends. Or explore Victorian-era shopping arcades like George and Pitt Street, filled with well-known retail stores.

Looking for some classic Australian souvenirs like opals, Aboriginal art or an Akubra hat? Scout The Rocks and Kirribilli Markets, where artists showcase their craftmanship in a colourful atmosphere. And try Paddington’s boutiques, a treasure trove of special finds crafted by the city’s artisans.

Don’t want to change out of your swimmers? You don’t need to leave the beach to shop – Bondi’s beachside stores are abundant with stylish beachwear and accessories.
AU.SYD.destinationPageIntro: Surf, swim, sunbathe and barbeque on repeat – get ready to relax Aussie-style when you say “g’day” to Sydney.
AU.SYD.overviewText:
Book a flight to Sydney and embark on an adventure down under. It’s easy to see why this city can be mistaken as Australia’s capital city with its iconic landmarks, vibrant urban areas and picturesque beaches. 

There are endless opportunities to enjoy Sydney whether you’re looking for metropolitan vibes or outdoorsy activities. Start by exploring its famous sights and venture off the beaten track with a hike in one of the nearby national parks. 

Whatever your itinerary is, make sure you incorporate surfing, swimming and sunbathing to really soak up the laid-back Australian lifestyle.
AU.SYD.destinationHighlightsH1: Sydney: The vibrant heart of Australia
AU.SYD.eatingImageText:
Sydney’s culinary scene is a delightful fusion of global flavours and Australian charm.

For a feeling of seaside sophistication, there are plenty of venues in Bondi Beach that serve delightful food, tasty beverages and provide stunning outlooks.

Get a taste of Sydney’s street food and authentic Australian cuisine with a visit to The Rocks Weekend Market. If you’d prefer to try Australia’s fresh produce and organic fare, visit Kings Cross Organic Market or Paddy’s Market.

Order a plate of Sydney Rock oysters or a barramundi fillet to get your fill of locally farmed seafood or enjoy a meat pie if you’re on the go.

Have a sweet tooth? It would be a crime to leave Australia without a packet of Tim Tams in your suitcase.

ZA.JNB.businessClassSummary:
Fly to Johannesburg in Business or First Class with Qatar Airways and explore South Africa’s bustling metropolis. Every element of your journey is carefully designed to bring you unmatched comfort and renowned service. 

Begin your trip with a seamless check-in process before unwinding in one of our Business Class lounges. Grab a light bite from the buffet or sip a cold drink while catching up on some reading. You can also tick a few items off your to-do list in one of the private workstations, or refresh with a shower before your flight. 

On board, settle into a spacious seat offering generous legroom and flexibility. Stay connected with high-speed Wi-Fi on our A380, A350, B787 and select B777 aircraft, making it simple to keep in touch with loved ones. At any time you like, you can relish the gourmet dishes from our à la carte menu, expertly prepared by award-winning chefs. When you’re ready to rest, recline into a lie-flat bed complete with soft linen, while ambient lighting helps your body adjust to your destination’s time zone.  

Book your Business or First Class flight to Johannesburg with Qatar Airways and indulge in unparalleled luxury.
ZA.JNB.touristAttractionsText:
Immerse yourself in South Africa’s rich history at Johannesburg’s Constitution Hill. This former prison tells powerful stories of the city’s resilience. For deeper insights into the nation’s political past, visit the Apartheid Museum.

Johannesburg’s history also comes alive in its vibrant arts scene. Explore galleries showcasing contemporary and traditional works, such as The Standard Bank Gallery. Or, enjoy a performance by local talent at the Market Theatre. Admire the street art adorning almost every wall, so abundant that you don’t even need to step foot in an art gallery.

For a unique paleoanthropological experience, venture to the Cradle of Humankind. This UNESCO World Heritage Site features ancient caves and fossils that trace millions of years of human evolution.
ZA.JNB.leisureActivitiesText:
Many travellers go to South Africa to experience its incredible wildlife. Get up close to majestic lions, cheetahs, and giraffes at the Lion and Safari Park. Alternatively, drive to the Rhino and Lion Nature Reserve to admire these fascinating mammals in their natural habitat.

For thrill-seekers, the Gold Reef City area offers a blend of history and high-octane excitement. This entertainment centre, set in an old gold mine, also features dining and shopping options. Another popular destination is Sun City, which caters to diverse tastes with its golf courses, luxurious spas, water parks, and restaurants.

When it’s time to unwind, visit Zoo Lake for a moment of tranquillity. Rent a boat to paddle across the water or enjoy a picnic in the afternoon sun.
ZA.JNB.shoppingText:
After your coffee in the Maboneng Precinct, wander through the eclectic stores in the village – the perfect spot to find bespoke fashion and artwork that embodies the spirit of Johannesburg.

For a lively retail experience, visit the Playground Market. Enjoy a gourmet snack, live music, and a variety of stalls. The market culture is vibrant, with the Rosebank Sunday Market offering a treasure trove of handmade crafts, vintage goods, and delicious street food.

Don't miss the authentically South African experience of shopping at the African Craft Market. Here, you can find colourful beaded jewellery, hand-woven baskets, and painted pottery showcasing intricate African artistry.
ZA.JNB.destinationPageIntro: A melting pot of cultures, Johannesburg sizzles with music, art and flavours from across Africa and beyond.
ZA.JNB.overviewText:
Johannesburg, a city known for its vibrant energy that shines as brightly as the sun. Discover a dynamic metropolis brimming with adventure at every turn. Stroll through its lively streets that pulsate with local rhythms. Savour tantalising street food and admire colourful murals that tell the nation’s stories.

Explore Johannesburg’s rich history at its landmarks and museums, or embark on a safari at nearby wildlife reserves. Whether you’re drawn by the arts, cuisine, nature, or historic culture, Johannesburg guarantees an unforgettable holiday.
ZA.JNB.destinationHighlightsH1: Johannesburg: The vibrant heartbeat of South Africa
ZA.JNB.eatingImageText:
Start your day with a brewed coffee and a rusk cookie at a hip café in the Maboneng Precinct, Johannesburg’s hub for street art and trendy dining.

When visiting Soweto, be sure to stop by one of the eateries on Vilakazi Street. Enjoy umleqwa, a hearty Xhosa-style chicken stew served with pap, a maize porridge that is the nation’s comfort food.

As the sun sets, head to Melville – a bohemian enclave brimming with delightful South African restaurants. Savour crispy samosas, followed by a juicy boerewors sausage made from a blend of meats and spices.

No foodie adventure in Johannesburg is complete without visiting one of its renowned meat houses, where you can try an array of game meats. Kudu, anyone?

TH.BKK.businessClassSummary:
Travel to Bangkok in Business or First Class with Qatar Airways and fly in style to one of the most vibrant cities on earth. Your every need is taken care of by our world-class team, who greet you with a smile and ensure your trip is one to remember.

Before your flight, relax in one of our elegant Business Class lounges, offering a tranquil space to work or unwind. You could check your emails, hop on a call, or even watch a few videos. To freshen up, take a shower or savour a menu of drinks and light snacks. When it’s time to board, our state-of-the-art aircraft are waiting for you, with luxurious cabins, indulgently large seats, and plenty of legroom. The soft, ambient lighting prepares you to easily adjust to your destination’s time zone.

Gourmet meals are prepared by our award-winning chefs, with an à la carte menu that sets the standard for premium cuisine. After your delicious meal, choose some in-flight entertainment from our comprehensive selection, or make the most of your lie-flat bed to get some rest. With fast, reliable Wi-Fi on our fleet of A380, A350, B787 and select B777 aircraft, you can also stay in touch with loved ones or colleagues.

Travelling in Business or First Class takes you around the world in total comfort. Book your flight to Bangkok with Qatar Airways today.
TH.BKK.touristAttractionsText:
In addition to the Wat Arun and Wat Pho temples, a visit to the iconic Grand Palace should also be on your itinerary. Not only is the Palace’s dazzling architecture a masterpiece to marvel at, but Wat Phra Kaew temple located within its grounds houses the impressive Emerald Buddha – made entirely from jade and dating back to the 12th or 13th century.

To truly experience the liveliness of Bangkok, explore the vibrant neighbourhood of Banglamphu. Stroll down Khao San Road, the centre of it all, where ancient temples and lively markets converge. 

If you’d prefer to see the city from above, visit the SkyWalk at King Power Mahanakhon, which stands 78 floors (310m) above the ground. While it may be a hair-raising experience for some, it offers uninterrupted 360-degree views of Bangkok.
TH.BKK.leisureActivitiesText:
Step away from the bustling city for a moment and take a sunset boat cruise along Chao Phraya River. Witness views of the golden temples and Bangkok’s illuminated skyline from the serenity of the water. Most boats offer candlelit dinners, providing the perfect setting for couples. 

A trip to Thailand wouldn’t be complete without a little indulgence. Experience ultimate relaxation and rejuvenation with a traditional Thai massage at one of the many spas scattered across the city. If it’s just your feet that need a little pampering, pop into one of the street-side foot spas for a rejuvenating foot massage.

For a serene escape from the city buzz, head to the tranquil oasis of Lumpini Park. Unwind in the lush greenery and spot monitor lizards as they roam freely within the parklands.
TH.BKK.shoppingText:
Head to Chatuchak Weekend Market – a one-of-a-kind shopping experience. This weekend-only market offers everything from local handicrafts and souvenirs to exotic street food.

Spend some Baht at one of Bangkok’s many megamalls, your one-stop-shop for shopping, dining and exclusive experiences. 

Bangkok is also renowned for its tailoring services. If you can’t find what you are looking for in the many malls and markets, visit one of the city’s tailors to see if an item can be specially made for you.

Antiques roadshow, anyone? For vintage shopping, Papaya Studio may be the place to go. This warehouse is filled with 19th and 20th century antiques, from art-deco furniture to VHS players.
TH.BKK.destinationPageIntro: From floating markets and lively street scenes to ancient temples and palaces, visitors to Bangkok are in for a fascinating urban experience.
TH.BKK.overviewText:
Visit Bangkok, the vibrant capital of Thailand. This city has it all: sights, sounds, flavours and ancient traditions blending with modernity. From awe-inspiring temples, lively floating markets, luxurious megamalls, and culinary delights – there is something for everyone to enjoy in Bangkok. 

Explore ancient temples such as Wat Arun and Wat Pho and be mesmerised by the giant Reclining Buddha. Cruise along the Chao Phraya River to see the sights from the water, then indulge in delicious mango sticky rice from a bustling street market. With its eclectic mix of new versus old, Bangkok is a city that never fails to inspire.
TH.BKK.destinationHighlightsH1: Bangkok: A kaleidoscope for the senses
TH.BKK.eatingImageText:
Graze through an abundance of tastes and flavours at a night market. There are many dotted around Bangkok, bursting with outdoor food stalls and places to socialise. Talat Rot Fai Srinakharin in Northern Bangkok is one of the most popular late-night experiences. Here you can sample fiery curries, aromatic noodle soups and seafood dishes that the city is famous for.

Visit a floating market, such as Damnoen Saduak or Amphawa. Explore the maze-like alleyways of Chinatown, where you can indulge in mouthwatering dishes like savoury dumplings and sweet mango sticky rice. Don’t forget to order coconut water to wash it all down.

For something a little different, book yourself a Thai cooking class to continue enjoying delicious Thai dishes at home.

TR.IST.businessClassSummary:
Fly to Istanbul in Business or First Class with Qatar Airways and journey to the crossroads between East and West in unmatched luxury. From the moment you check in, our world-renowned team will look after your wellbeing to ensure that your experience is unforgettable. 

Begin by relaxing in one of our exclusive Business Class lounges. Here, you can freshen up with an invigorating shower, find a quiet spot to read, check your emails, or sip on a revitalising beverage before your flight is called. Once onboard our state-of-the-art aircraft, relax in your spacious seat, with plenty of legroom so you can stretch out.  

During the flight, our professional cabin crew will attend to your every need. They’ll serve delicious meals from our à la carte menu, freshly prepared by award-winning chefs. After indulging in gourmet cuisine, unwind with a film, game or TV show from our wide range of entertainment options. Then connect to the high-speed Wi-Fi to join an important video meeting, or enjoy a restful sleep on a supremely comfortable lie-flat bed.   

Book a flight to Istanbul in Business or First Class with Qatar Airways and begin your journey to the meeting point between Europe and Asia.
TR.IST.touristAttractionsText:
In a city where the East meets the West, lies a treasure trove of historical and cultural encounters. Begin your journey at the Blue Mosque, an architectural marvel adorned with spectacular blue tiles. Just a short stroll away is the Hagia Sophia, a magnificent structure that has served as a place of worship, and now stands as a museum showcasing rich history. Nearby, you can explore the Basilica Cistern, an ancient underground reservoir with a mystical ambience.

Hop on the tram to Dolmabahçe Palace for a glimpse into the lavish lifestyles of Ottoman sultans. Not far from there is the Topkapi Palace, where you can wander through its courtyards and admire a vast collection of artefacts.

Ascend to the top of Galata Tower, a medieval stone tower with panoramic views of the city.
TR.IST.leisureActivitiesText:
Few places offer the unique opportunity to be in one country, yet visit two continents. A Bosphorus cruise is a must-do – glide between Europe and Asia, while enjoying stunning views of palaces, mosques and the city skyline.

History enthusiasts will love the Istanbul Archaeology Museum. Or, if art is more your taste, check out the Istanbul Modern, Pera Museum, and SALT Beyoğlu.

For a quintessentially Turkish experience, indulge in a hamam or Turkish bath, where you can enjoy traditional rituals, steam and massage for a rejuvenating treat.

For a serene escape, take a day trip to the Princes’ Islands of Büyükada, Heybeliada, Burgazada, and Kınalıada. These islands offer a classic Turkish experience, complete with historic mansions and beautiful beaches.
TR.IST.shoppingText:
Start your shopping adventure at the Grand Bazaar, one of the world’s largest and oldest covered markets. Here, you’ll find everything from ceramics and Ottaman jewellery, to Turkish tea sets and colourful kilims.

Nearby, the Spice Bazaar is also a must-visit for its exotic spices, dried fruits and sweets. Don’t forget to pick up some delicious Turkish delight as an edible souvenir.

For a more modern shopping experience, stroll down Istiklal Street in Beyoğlu, lined with international brands, high-end boutiques, and charming shops. The Galata district is known for its eclectic stores of unique fashion, jewellery and one-of-a-kind pieces. Meanwhile, Karaköy offers a trendy, artistic vibe with showrooms, galleries and designer boutiques.
TR.IST.destinationPageIntro: In Istanbul, the Hippodrome, Blue Mosque and Ottoman Topkapi Palace will resonate with history buffs, while the charming bustle of the Grand Bazaar awaits the savvy shoppers.
TR.IST.overviewText:
Nestled between Asia and Europe, Istanbul is a city where cultures blend seamlessly. This vibrant metropolis captivates visitors with its rich traditions, diverse cuisine and unique lifestyles. Each neighbourhood tells its own story – some with a bohemian charm, while others are steeped in age-old customs.

The streets are alive with bustling markets and the enticing aromas of local delicacies. And you can discover the city’s storied past at its many galleries, museums and lively arts scene. Its location along the Bosphorus Strait offers stunning waterfronts, breathtaking vistas and a variety of recreational activities.

Istanbul is a city that beckons you to explore, experience and immerse yourself in the authentic Turkish life.
TR.IST.eatingImageText:
Karaköy is a culinary haven, offering a range of dining options with everything from authentic Turkish dishes to modern tavern fare. This vibrant neighbourhood is perfect for a leisurely lunch or a stylish dinner. Try the testi kebab, a slow-cooked meat stew served in a clay pot that’s dramatically cracked open at your table.

In the Beyoğlu district, embrace the lively vibe of meyhanes. These traditional taverns serve meze – small, sharing dishes – and fresh fish, all paired with locally brewed beverages. And while you’re in Istanbul, grab yourself some late-night street food. Friendly vendors offer delectable doner kebabs and simit – sesame-encrusted bread rings.

Make sure to start one of your days with a hearty Turkish breakfast, and end it with a fun Turkish ice cream order.

PH.MNL.businessClassSummary:
Book a flight to Manila in Business Class or First Class with Qatar Airways and arrive at one of the world’s most exciting destinations in unmatched style. With an incomparable team taking care of your every need and modern aircraft offering a luxurious experience, flying to the Philippines is a truly outstanding experience. 

Start your journey by heading to our Business Class Lounge, where you can sip a refreshing drink while checking your emails or take a hot shower before boarding. Once your flight is called, our professional cabin crew greets you and escorts you to your exceptionally comfortable seat. The generous legroom lets you stretch out and unwind. 

Thanks to the super-fast Wi-Fi onboard our A380, A350, B787 and select B777 aircraft, you can join that important video meeting as planned with no glitches or interruptions. Indulge your love of fine cuisine with a choice of exquisite meals from our a la carte menu, followed by a film or game from our wide range of entertainment options. Arrive in Manila feeling refreshed after a restful sleep on a lie-flat bed, while ambient lighting resets your body to the destination’s time zone.

Fly to Manila with Qatar Airways in Business or First Class and enjoy the most exclusive way to travel to the Pacific Rim.
PH.MNL.touristAttractionsText:
Begin your Manila journey at Fort Santiago, a historic citadel that stands as a symbol of Manila’s resilience and heritage. Discover European architecture and extravagant interiors from the 17th to 18th century all around the city.

Dig deeper into Manila’s past and explore Casa Manila. This preserved mansion exemplifies the city’s Spanish colonial era.

The renowned Rizal Monument is a towering structure and an icon of the Philippine’s history and independence.

For a glimpse of Manila’s multicultural aspects, head to Binondo, home of the world’s oldest Chinatown. Stroll along its lively streets, try authentic Chinese food and enjoy the view of Jones Bridge.
PH.MNL.leisureActivitiesText:
Appreciate the contrast of Manila’s old and new city on foot or by bicycle with plenty of tours through the classic streets of Intramuros and the modern skyscrapers of Makati.

Immerse yourself in the vibrant arts scene of Manila, with visits to the National Gallery of Art or the Cultural Center of the Philippines. Examine contemporary Filipino art in exhibitions, performances and events that showcase the creativity and talent of the nation’s artists.

Another popular activity is taking a day trip from Manila to Mount Pinatubo, an active volcano. Marvel at the beauty of this active volcano and embark on a 2.5-hour trek. Discover rugged landscapes, swim in crater lakes and enjoy spectacular views from the summit.
PH.MNL.shoppingText:
Shop for treasures and unique finds at Divisoria Market, Manila’s largest flea market. Find everything from souvenirs and handicrafts to clothes and accessories.

Manila is also home to many premier malls with a wide range of stores, boutiques and eateries. These establishments provide a one-stop experience for all your shopping needs. 

To sample fresh produce, local delicacies and artisanal goods, venture to San Andres Market and embrace the atmosphere of a bustling farmers market.
PH.MNL.destinationPageIntro: Known as the 'Pearl of the Orient', Manilla is a lively hub of Philippine culture, food and landscapes.
PH.MNL.overviewText:
Tradition, culture and modernity converge at the heart of the Philippines in Manila. With Spanish colonial architecture intertwined with contemporary skyscrapers, this sprawling city is known for its unique urban landscape.

There’s an abundance of sights and activities waiting to be discovered, from ancient forts and a thriving art world to volcanic islands and distinct cuisine.

Take in centuries of Filipino history, taste local dishes and explore colourful neighbourhoods as you experience the best that Manila has to offer.
PH.MNL.destinationHighlightsH1: Manila: A blend of history and modernity
PH.MNL.eatingImageText:
While Filipino cuisine may not be as well-known as its Asian counterparts, Manila has a plethora of delicious dining options to fulfill your appetite after a day of sightseeing. Indulge in traditional fare such as adobo, a marinated meat dish with rice. Or taste the hearty flavours of sinigang, a savoury and sour soup. Several restaurants are housed within the Spanish colonial buildings, providing a majestic and historical setting for your meal.

If you have time, take a day trip to Tagaytay. This foodie town has earned its place on the map for its stunning landscapes and delectable dining. Have a taste of bulalo – a beef and bone marrow soup – or try some freshwater sardines as you look out over the incredible Taal Lake and Taal Volcano.

NP.KTM.touristAttractionsText:
Kathmandu is famously known as the base location from where thrill-seekers begin their hiking journey up Mount Everest. Alternatively, you can take off on a scenic plane or helicopter ride from Kathmandu for a panoramic tour of the Earth’s highest mountain. 

To embrace the beauty of Kathmandu beyond the Himalayas, explore the historic royal palaces of Hanuman Dhoka or one of the few remaining Buddhist monasteries, Itum Bahal. You can also visit the religious complex of Swayambhunath Stupa, known as the monkey temple for its resident primates.

Relax on the terraces along the Bagmati River and marvel at the Pashupatinath Temple, the most revered Hindu temple in Nepal.
NP.KTM.leisureActivitiesText:
Spend time uncovering the secrets of hidden alleyways and temples scattered throughout the city. Experience Kathmandu’s charm by getting around by rickshaw, allowing you to soak in the sights and sounds of daily Nepalese life.

Enjoy peaceful lush greenery and ponds – a welcome escape after a few days in the city – with a walk through the enchanting Garden of Dreams. Then, unwind in Mohan Chowk and Kalidaman Chowk by admiring the classical architecture while soaking up the tranquil garden surroundings.
NP.KTM.shoppingText:
Kathmandu has plenty of markets and unique artisan stores in which to do your holiday shopping. Visit the Ason or Mangal Bazaars for authentic artisanal goods, such as handmade textiles, pottery and jewellery. Discover the artistry of rice paper which is intricately crafted to create journals, lanterns and artwork. Looking for the perfect souvenir? Aromatic Nepali tea is an ideal gift.

If you are an outdoor enthusiast, Kathmandu is home to a treasure trove of hiking gear. From sturdy boots to high quality backpacks, you will be well-equipped for your Himalayan adventure – even if you forget your gear!
NP.KTM.destinationPageIntro: Be charmed by Kathmandu – home to ancient temples, impressive palaces, and traditions as old as the Himalayas that surround it.
NP.KTM.overviewText:
Nestled in the heart of Nepal, Kathmandu offers an unforgettable blend of natural wonders, spiritual sanctuaries and delicious cuisine.

Serving as the gateway to the picturesque Himalayas, it is a popular destination for hikers and climbers. If you prefer to admire Mount Everest from afar, there are plenty of other activities to pique your interest – discover ancient temples, indulge in local dishes or explore popular bazaars.
NP.KTM.eatingImageText:
Culinary adventures await at every turn in the vibrant Thamel district, just a 10-minute walk from the centre of Kathmandu. It serves as a gastronomic hub, with many restaurants and food markets that suit any mood or budget.

Dine in a traditional restaurant to witness the ceremonial handwashing that symbolises hospitality and gratitude. While there, enjoy dhaal chaat – the quintessential Nepalese meal of rice, lentil soup and assorted vegetables. For something special to the locals, try chataamari, a rice crepe seasoned with spices. 

No trip to Kathmandu is complete without sampling the infamous momos – savoury dumplings filled with meat or vegetables, served with spicy dipping sauces.

CA.YYZ.shortDescription: Explore the culturally diverse city of Toronto, with its towering skyscrapers and natural wonders.
CA.YYZ.touristAttractionsText:
As one of the most iconic buildings in Toronto’s skyline, the CN Tower is a must-do. At the top lies a revolving restaurant with 360-degree views of the city and Lake Ontario. 

Head to Nathan Phillips Square, a lively hub surrounding the Toronto City Hall. Snap a photo with the ‘Toronto’ sign, and if you’re visiting in winter, lace up some skates and glide across the ice rink. 

For a breath of fresh air, explore the Toronto Harbourfront. The Music Garden, designed by cellist Yo-Yo Ma, is a peaceful retreat where music and nature intertwine. 

Of course, no trip to Toronto is complete without an outing to the majestic Niagara Falls. The thundering waters and misty spray will leave you breathless, whether you admire it from the viewing platform or embark on a boat ride into the whitewater.
CA.YYZ.leisureActivitiesText:
Take a ferry ride on Lake Ontario over to the serene Toronto Islands. They offer a perfect nature break from the city’s hustle and bustle where you can relax on sandy beaches, explore scenic bike paths and enjoy spectacular viewpoints of the city skyline.

For sports fans, the Hockey Hall of Fame is a must-visit to relive hockey’s greatest moments. For history and culture enthusiasts, journey through time at the Royal Ontario Museum and find everything from dinosaur fossils to world-class art exhibitions. 

In the summer, visit Casa Loma for Symphony in the Gardens, where orchestral music fills the air. In September, don’t miss the Toronto International Film Festival, where Hollywood meets Toronto’s arts scene.
CA.YYZ.shoppingText:
Yonge Street, known as the longest street in the world, is the place to be for shopping and Canadian retail therapy. With over 600 interconnected stores and malls, there are many global brands and unique local finds to browse through.  

In the winter, explore the PATH – Toronto’s 30-kilometre underground walkway. Connecting restaurants, boutiques and big-name stores, it’s idyllic for those wanting to shop in comfort even when it’s snowing outside. 

For a more bohemian vibe, visit the eclectic Kensington Market with its quirky boutiques, vintage finds and handcrafted items. The colourful streets are abundant with treasures at every turn. Ensure to pick up some maple syrup on your travels, Canada’s sweet golden export.
CA.YYZ.destinationPageIntro: Explore the culturally diverse city of Toronto, with its towering skyscrapers and natural wonders.
CA.YYZ.overviewText:
Toronto is a living mosaic of faces, languages and stories that make every corner hum with life. It’s an effortless blend of cultures, cuisines and creativity. Mornings begin with fresh coffee and bustling marketplaces, while afternoons are made for wandering vibrant neighbourhoods.

The skyline stands tall, yet its parks and waterfront spots offer moments of calm amid urban excitement. Each season brings its own magic too, with winter ushering the cosiness of underground adventures and warm gatherings, while summer spills out into the streets with festivals, food and music.
CA.YYZ.eatingImageText:
Vendors showcase the best of local produce, cheeses and artisanal goods at the St. Lawrence Market. Grab yourself a beavertail – a Canadian pastry consisting of deep-fried dough smothered in chocolate hazelnut spread or apple pie filling.

Stroll through the charming Distillery District, a cobblestone haven known for its mix of hip restaurants and bespoke shops. The district’s mix of historic architecture and modern flavours makes it a must-see.

It wouldn’t be a holiday to Canada without trying the national dish, poutine. Whether you enjoy it in its classic form – fries covered in rich gravy and cheese curds – or with creative twists (like truffle oil and vegetables) it’s a guilty pleasure you won’t forget.

EG.CAI.businessClassSummary:

Bask in an extraordinary experience with our world-renowned team graciously taking care of you. Every element of your journey, from the moment you check in to the moment you land, is carefully designed to meet your needs. 

Your trip to Cairo starts with slick and efficient check-in, followed by a relaxing break in one of our elegant Business Class lounges. When it’s called, step onboard our state-of-the-art aircraft and be instantly shown to your seat by our award-winning cabin crew.  

As you settle in, enjoy the generous legroom of your ergonomically designed seat while connecting to the high-speed Wi-Fi – available on our A380, A350, B787 and select B777 aircraft. Indulge your love of fine cuisine with a meal from our à la carte menu, followed by a film from our wide variety of entertainment options. Then catch up on some sleep in a lie-flat bed, while the ambient lighting helps your body adjust to your destination’s time zone.  

Book a Business or First Class flight to Cairo with Qatar Airways and travel in unmatched style.
EG.CAI.touristAttractionsText:
At the heart of Cairo’s allure, and just a short drive from the city centre, is the ancient architectural wonder – the Great Pyramids of Giza and Sphinx. No trip to Cairo is complete without a visit to these timeless icons, whose mind-blowing engineering continues to captivate travellers with their grandeur and mystery. Built more than 4,000 years ago, they are the oldest of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

Visit the chic neighbourhood of Zamalek – sometimes dubbed as the ‘Manhattan of Cairo’ – and explore its many cultural venues. You’ll be able to spot the Cairo Tower nearby. Ascend this 187-metre-tall structure for panoramic views of the city. On a clear day, you can see as far as the pyramids on the distant horizon.

Don’t miss a tour through the Cairo Citadel, a medieval fortress that houses the stunning Mohammed Ali Mosque. This historic site offers a glimpse into Cairo’s past and provides breathtaking views of the city.
EG.CAI.leisureActivitiesText:
Begin your adventure at the Egyptian Museum, where the golden mask of Tutankhamun and intricate hieroglyphs transport you back to the era of pharaohs and gods. For a deeper dive into Egypt’s storied past, head to the Grand Egyptian Museum, set to be the largest archaeological museum dedicated to a single civilisation. You’ll be awed by treasures that span thousands of years.

Be sure to explore the winding streets of Old Cairo, where the city’s rich heritage is reflected in its intricate architectural landmarks and iconic religious sites.

No visit to Cairo is complete without a leisurely cruise down the Nile River. Board a traditional felucca and watch the sun dip below the horizon, as you take in the sights and sounds of Cairo from the water.
EG.CAI.shoppingText:
Providing a blend of ancient treasures and modern delights, Cairo’s shopping scene is one to impress. From upscale malls to traditional bazaars, the city offers a shopping experience like no other.

Khan El-Khalili Bazaar is a must-visit. This historic souk isn’t just a marketplace, but a vibrant cultural experience. Wander through its lively alleys to find aromatic spices, beautiful jewellery, ornate lamps and other unique souvenirs.

Venture on to Khayamia Street, renowned for its exquisite textiles and traditional handicrafts. Here, you can find beautifully embroidered fabrics, each piece telling a story of craftsmanship and tradition.
EG.CAI.destinationPageIntro: Pyramids and Sphinx aside, Cairo is bursting with museums and monuments that celebrate both the recent and distant past.
EG.CAI.overviewText:
Embark on a journey to a city steeped in history and home to one of the Seven Wonders of the World, the Pyramids of Giza. Nestled along the serene banks of the Nile River, Cairo is the largest city in the Arab world, brimming with iconic landmarks and rich cultural experiences.

Marvel at the ancient wonders, from the majestic Pyramids to the treasures of the Egyptian Museum. Wander through the bustling bazaars and savour the flavours of traditional Egyptian cuisine.

From the tranquil banks of the Nile to the lively streets of downtown, Cairo offers a captivating blend of activities and sights. Whether you’re exploring its ancient history or enjoying its modern delights, Cairo promises an unforgettable adventure.
EG.CAI.destinationHighlightsH1: Cairo: The heart and soul of Egypt
EG.CAI.eatingImageText:
Start your day with some falafel and a bowl of foul medames –a breakfast staple of fava beans, mixed with lemon, olive oil, and extras like chopped onions, tomatoes, parsley, and tahini.

Try kushari for lunch or dinner – it’s a hearty comfort dish of rice, macaroni, lentils, and chickpeas, topped with tomato sauce and crispy onions. Another must-try is hawawshi – Egyptian bread is stuffed with ground beef that’s seasoned with warm spices, onions, and chilli peppers. Make sure to also grab an Egyptian-style shawarma sandwich from one of the hole-in-the-wall eateries.

Craving dessert? The options are endless. Treat yourself to the beloved traditional basbousa (a syrup-soaked semolina cake) or Umm Ali (a layered bread pudding, baked in sweet milk and topped with nuts, raisins, and coconut).
