Fly with Qatar Airways in Business or First Class for a remarkable trip to one of the world’s most exotic locations.
MV.MLE.touristAttractionsText:
While there are many islands that appeal to travellers, Male is home to an array of attractions that are just as enriching. Start your exploration on Boduthakurufaanu Magu, the main thoroughfare of Male. From here, stroll through Sultan Park – an urban, green oasis. Next, visit Jumhooree Maidhaan, also known as Republic Square. For a thrilling adventure, hire a motorbike to navigate the streets of Male instead.

Be captivated by the National Museum, housed in the palace of a former sultan. It contains various artefacts that narrate the history and culture of the Maldives.

Set foot in a spiritual landmark, the Friday Mosque. Marvel at its architecture – coral stones adorned with carvings and lacquer work.
MV.MLE.leisureActivitiesText:
The Eastern side of Male boasts the best beaches, particularly in the Henveiru district. The pristine beaches are perfect for a typical Maldivian day, relaxing by the sea.

Venture off the coast of Male to one of the numerous islands the Maldives is famous for. The Fari Islands are close by and come highly recommended. Jet off on a short 45-minute speedboat ride to a land of high-end resorts and stunning scenic allure.

If you’re a marine enthusiast, travel to the northern Male Atoll. Dive into an incredible underwater world where you can swim with colourful fish, manta rays and even whale sharks.

If you’re seeking a few days of pure relaxation, make your way to the Kaafu Atoll. Choose from a variety of premium resorts for an indulgent holiday in the most idyllic setting.
MV.MLE.businessClassTitle: Business Class flights to the Maldives
MV.MLE.shoppingText:
Maldivian shopping is lowkey compared to its neighbouring Asian countries, with beachside boutiques and markets to explore rather than malls. Take some time to browse Male’s Local Market. It stocks everything from fresh fruit and vegetables to beautifully handcrafted souvenirs.

Look for a thundu kunaa, an authentic Maldivian mat made by local artisans. Marvel at the many items that can be crafted from coconuts and admire the artfully designed sarongs.

The food markets in the Maldives are a tourist attraction in their own right. Stop at one to experience the thriving atmosphere of a Maldivian market and discover exotic fish and fruits you may not have seen before.
MV.MLE.touristAttractionsTabHeading: Things to do in the Maldives
MV.MLE.destinationPageIntro: With its stunning white-sand beaches, lush resorts and breathtaking seascapes, the Maldives is the quintessential romantic getaway.
MV.MLE.overviewText:
The Maldives, an archipelago of unparalleled beauty in the Indian Ocean, is a well-known tropical destination. Renowned for its crystal-clear waters, pristine white-sand beaches and awe-inspiring coral reefs, the Maldives offers a sanctuary of tranquillity and luxury. Each of the 1,000-plus islands presents a unique blend of natural splendour, making it an ideal destination for both unwinding and adventure.

Experience world-class snorkelling and scuba diving or indulge at a luxurious resort and spa. Explore the cultural richness of the Maldives’ capital, Male, which provides all kinds of insights into its storied past.

Whether you’re embarking on a romantic getaway, a family vacation or a solo retreat, the Maldives promises an inspiring and rejuvenating escape.
MV.MLE.destinationHighlightsH1: The Maldives: Islands of unparalleled beauty
MV.MLE.eatingImageText:
Whether dining at a five-star resort or a local café, every meal in the Maldives is a celebration of the island’s culture and hospitality. Dine at one of the resort’s Maldivian Nights, where a buffet of national cuisine is served. At the heart of these dishes are the flavours of coconut and tuna, iconic ingredients in this island country.

Try mashuni, a breakfast staple of shredded tuna mixed with coconut, onions and chilli with warm flatbread. Other traditional meals to order include hedhikaa – a snacking plate of tuna, coconut, potatoes and egg; and mas kaashi – a popular dish of dried fish and coconut.

The Maldives also has a vibrant café scene that captures the essence of relaxed island life.

Book a flight to Milan in Business or First Class with Qatar Airways for a world-class travel experience.
IT.MXP.touristAttractionsText:
Exploring Milan starts with the iconic Duomo. This stunning Gothic cathedral with an intricate façade is a must-see attraction. It offers panoramic rooftop views and epitomises Milan’s architectural grandeur.

The Basilica of Sant’Ambrogio is one of the city’s oldest churches. Its Roman architecture and historical significance make it a fascinating site for people interested in art and religious history.

Take a stroll to the Arco della Pace, a neoclassical arch situated at the end of Corso Sempione. Then witness an operatic performance at La Scala, one of the world’s most renowned opera houses.

For a unique and somewhat eerie experience, visit San Bernardino alle Ossa. Adorned with human bones and skulls, this chapel is a stark contrast to Milan’s more traditional attractions.
IT.MXP.leisureActivitiesText:
The museums of Milan are some of Europe’s best. Begin your tour at the Castello Sforzesco, a majestic fortress that houses numerous museums and art collections.

Pinocoteca di Brera and Pinocoteca Ambrosiana stand out as must-visit galleries, featuring Italian Renaissance art. The creative district of Brera is bustling with art studios, boutiques and quaint cafés. Leonardo da Vinci’s The Last Supper, located in the refectory of the Convent of Santa Maria delle Grazia, is another must-see.

For a change of pace, wander down the Navigli, Milan’s canal district to find shops, eateries and taverns. Alternatively, you could travel out of the city to Lake Como for panoramic views of spectacular mountains and charming Italian villages.
IT.MXP.shoppingText:
Milan is a world-class shopping destination that caters to all styles and tastes. The city’s fashion district, Quadrilatero d’Oro, is home to exclusive boutiques showcasing the latest creations from Italy’s top designers. Bring home a designer garment or some Italian leather goods to remember your Milanese adventure.

For a unique shopping experience, visit one of the world’s oldest shopping malls. It’s an architectural marvel, as well as one of the best places to shop.

Beyond fashion, there are monthly antiques markets in the Navigli district. You can find mercati – traditional Italian street markets – all around the city stocked with fresh produce, artisanal local foods and handmade crafts.
IT.MXP.destinationPageIntro: Milan, the fashion capital of the world, promises to greet you in style with the stunning Duomo, the operas of La Scala and hundreds of museums paying tribute to the old masters.
IT.MXP.overviewText:
The world’s fashion and design capital, Milan, is a hub of creativity and sophistication. Its energy is palpable, from its bustling streets filled with boutiques and al fresco cafés, to its grand, historic landmarks that narrate the rich, cultural heritage.

This cosmopolitan city is bursting with activity. Meander through galleries and museums and indulge in delicious Italian cuisine. Milan is ideal for a leisurely stroll to see the sights and discover hidden gems, or a bike ride to explore the city on wheels.

Venture out of the city to uncover the beauty of Lake Como – it’s the perfect European countryside getaway.
IT.MXP.destinationHighlightsH1: Milan: Fashion capital of the world
IT.MXP.eatingImageText:
Milan’s culinary scene is a blend of old and new, with Lombardy origins and international influences. Classical osterias serve hearty dishes like risotto all’onda and cotoletta Milanese, while avant-garde pizzerias push the boundaries of flavour and creativity.

Aperitivo hour is a rite of passage in Milan. Unwind with a beverage and an array of small bites. Stroll through market stalls and savour the seasonal delight of panettone, a festive sweet bread.

Corso Como is an area well known for its selection of local and international cuisine. International cuisine has a notable presence throughout Milan’s food culture, with a number of highly regarded Japanese and Chinese restaurants.

Finally, make sure to try the city’s signature dish, risotto alla Milanese – made of rice, broth, saffron and cheese.

DE.MUC.businessClassSummary:
Fly to Munich in Business or First Class with Qatar Airways and embark on a sophisticated journey to Germany’s cultural heart. From take-off to landing, our team ensures your experience is as effortless as it is memorable.

Start your trip with a fast check-in process before enjoying a peaceful break in one of our Business Class lounges. Savour a light snack from the buffet or sip on a revitalising drink while relaxing in elegant surroundings. Use one of the private workstations to check your emails, or take a hot shower to freshen up before your flight.

On board, indulge in superior comfort as you recline in an expansive seat with ample legroom. You can stay connected with high-speed Wi-Fi, available on our A380, A350, B787 and select B777 aircraft. Whenever you prefer to dine, choose from a variety of carefully curated dishes on our à la carte menu, prepared by our award-winning chefs. To get some sleep, rest on a lie-flat bed with soft linen, while ambient lighting gently adjusts your body to your destination’s time zone.

Book your Business or First Class flight to Munich with Qatar Airways and travel the world in style.
DE.MUC.touristAttractionsText:
Head to Munich’s central square, the Marienplatz, to watch the Glockenspiel’s characters tell stories of knights and royals, and enjoy the aroma of roasted chestnuts at the winter markets.

Museum enthusiasts must visit the Deutsches Museum – a playground for curious minds. It’s filled with everything from old-school planes to mind-boggling science experiments. 

For a slice of history, visit the Frauenkirche to appreciate Bavaria’s Gothic architecture. Walk through the gardens of Nymphenburg Palace, a royal retreat of lush greenery once roamed by Bavarian royalty.

Football fans cannot miss the Altes Rathaus (Old Town Hall) and the Neues Rathaus (New Town Hall). It’s where victories of the city’s club are celebrated with much fanfare and the team can be seen cheering from a balcony.
DE.MUC.leisureActivitiesText:
In autumn, the city bursts into a sea of festivities during Oktoberfest. Dress in a classical lederhosen or dirndl, as the city buzzes with music and laughter. In winter, you can ski down the slopes of Zugspitze, Germany’s highest peak. Year-round, but primarily in the summer, catch a glimpse of surfers riding waves at the Eisbach River in the Englischer Garten. Alternatively, soak up the sun on the banks of the Isar River.

The Kunstareal district is a must-see for art lovers. Its array of world-class museums and galleries are like stepping into a cultural treasure trove of works by artistic geniuses.

If you have little ones, visit the Hellebrunn Zoo. This is the world’s first ‘geo-zoo’, where animals are grouped based on their native habitats around the world.
DE.MUC.shoppingText:
Visit Maximilianstraße, where luxury and glamour can be found on every corner. Admire numerous designer boutiques and high-end jewellery stores for indulgent retail therapy or a taste of the high life.

For a change of pace, discover the hustle and bustle of Kaufingerstraße and Neuhauser Straße. These pedestrian streets are the heartbeat of Munich’s shopping scene. You can find all sorts of treasures, from fashion pieces and souvenirs, to local goods. If you’re looking for somewhere to buy your traditional German attire, these streets are a good place to start.

On the hunt for something special? Head to Glockenbachviertel, with its selection of unique stores and indie boutiques.
DE.MUC.destinationPageIntro: From a plethora of museums near Marienplatz, iconic football spots, and the nearby ski slopes of Zugspitze, Munich is a city with something for every traveller.
DE.MUC.overviewText:
Munich offers travellers a holiday destination that is rich in culture, charm and excitement. Make your way down streets that blend age-old traditions with vibrant, contemporary life. Munich’s architectural beauty tells stories of the past, bustling squares burst with cafés, and the aroma of freshly baked pretzels will make your mouth water.

The city is often alive with festivals, markets and events that celebrate its heritage and dynamic culture, ensuring there is always something new to discover. Stroll through leafy parks, uncover history at a museum or relax on the bank of the Isar River. Munich offers a travel experience that is both diverse and delightful.
DE.MUC.destinationHighlightsH1: Munich: The cultural gem of Bavaria
DE.MUC.eatingImageText:
Start your day with a hearty German breakfast, where fresh bread, cold cuts and cheeses are paired with strong coffee – setting the tone for a day of exploration. As you take in the city sights, the smell of pretzels is sure to lead you to a food cart.

At the legendary Hofbräuhaus, you can immerse yourself in Munich’s lively atmosphere while enjoying classic Bavarian fare like juicy roast meats and fluffy potato dumplings. If you’re lucky, you may hear the oompah band strike a tune.

No visit to Munich is complete without trying the city’s iconic Weißwurst sausage, a white sausage typically served with sweet mustard and a pretzel on the side. 

Shopping for food in Viktualienmarkt is another must-do. The market overflows with local produce, artisanal cheeses and delightful sweets.

Book your Business or First Class flight to Madrid with Qatar Airways for an unforgettable, world-class travel experience.
ES.MAD.touristAttractionsText:
Begin your Spanish exploration at the Royal Palace, where you can marvel at the largest royal residence in Western Europe. Nearby lies Plaza Mayor, where you can enjoy a coffee at one of the numerous cafés while admiring the grand architecture and colourful atmosphere. Next, experience the city’s energy in Puerta del Sol and see the clock tower in the centre.

Appreciate the striking landmark, Cibeles Fountain. Located in the bustling Plaza de Cibeles, it is an iconic symbol of Madrid. For something a little off the beaten path, head to San Antonio de los Alemanes. Its stunning frescoes and intricate baroque architecture make it a hidden gem worth discovering.

Love football? Don’t miss the Santiago Bernabéu Stadium, the home of many legendary football matches.
ES.MAD.leisureActivitiesText:
The most renowned tourist attraction in Madrid is the Prado Museum. This premier art institution houses masterpieces by Velázquez, Goya, and El Greco. Originally built to showcase the Spanish royal collection in the 1800s, it has since grown to display over 9,000 works of art. The building itself is sure to impress, exemplifying neoclassical style.

Not far away is the Thyssen-Bornemisza National Museum, boasting a plethora of works spanning from the Renaissance to the modern era. For contemporary art enthusiasts, the Reina Sofia Museum is a must-visit.

If you have exhausted all the museums and galleries in Madrid, stroll through El Retiro Park for a relaxing afternoon in nature. If it’s a nice summer day, hire a paddle boat on the lake.
ES.MAD.shoppingText:
Madrid is a shopping haven, presenting a blend of marketplaces, boutiques and streets dedicated to retail. Start your adventures at El Rasto, the city’s most famous flea market. Held every Sunday, this maze of stalls sells everything from antiques and vintage clothing to handicrafts and souvenirs.

For a taste of luxury, walk down Madrid’s Golden Mile in the Salamanca district. Home to high-end boutiques and flagship stores, as well as exclusive Spanish designers, you can be sure to purchase yourself a unique Spanish garment.

Gran Via is Madrid’s main thoroughfare, with a myriad of high-street brands, department stores and even theatres. Find more interesting items in the quaint neighbourhoods of Malasaña and Chueca. They are dotted with independent boutiques and vintage stores.
ES.MAD.destinationPageIntro: The colourful capital of Spain is bursting with culture, from art masterpieces in the Prado Museum, to culinary marketplace delights and dynamic shopping hotspots.
ES.MAD.overviewText:
Madrid is rich with history, reflected in its streets and landmarks. Its energetic vibe ignites visitors with its array of places to eat, shop, browse and explore. The artistic heritage is thriving, with an unparalleled art collection and museums that house worldly masterpieces.

The culinary scene is equally captivating, offering a tantalising mix of flavours in its local dishes and also international delights. From traditional markets to Michelin-starred restaurants, there are many locations to immerse yourself in the gastronomy of this Spanish capital.

With its inspiring cultural background, world-class shopping, and all-round lively atmosphere, Madrid promises an unforgettable European holiday.
ES.MAD.eatingImageText:
When in Madrid, indulge in small dishes that pack big flavours, tapas, available at most restaurants around the city.

For a food market like no other, go to the historic Mercado de San Miguel, situated near Plaza Mayor. Meander through the stalls and savour exquisite bites, including aromatic paella.

The Chueca neighbourhood is popular for its eclectic dining and is bursting with local eateries and bistros. Then experience the charm of ‘fondas’ – centuries-old restaurants that serve authentic Madrid dishes such as coido madrileño de tres vuelcos – a hearty stew.

Try a calamari sandwich, a favourite local snack and a Madrid specialty that is both simple and delicious. For a sweet treat, order churros dipped in hot chocolate.

Book a Business or First Class flight to Mumbai with Qatar Airways and enjoy unmatched comfort.
IN.BOM.touristAttractionsText:
Mumbai offers a plethora of experiences to suit every traveller’s taste. Start off your journey at the Taj Mahal Palace Hotel, an iconic 5-star establishment that is a symbol of luxury and represents Mumbai’s rich heritage of grandeur.

Explore the historic Gateway of India – this towering monument overlooking the city’s waterfront is a symbolic entrance to the country.

Venture on and take a trip to the ancient Elephanta Caves, a UNESCO World Heritage Site that showcases a collection of Hindu and Buddhist detailed rock-cut temples.

Worli Fort is also a great spot to explore – this centuries-old ruin is riddled with history and offers panoramic views of the city’s skyline.
IN.BOM.leisureActivitiesText:
Spend the day browsing the Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Vastu Sangrahalaya Museum, formerly known as the Prince of Wales Museum. This architectural marvel is home to an impressive collection of artefacts, art pieces and relics.

To take advantage of Mumbai’s seaside location, head to Juhu Beach – the longest beach in Mumbai. It’s a popular spot for relaxing, leisurely strolls or a picnic.

Stroll along Marine Drive, Mumbai’s iconic seaside promenade to witness the city’s vibrant energy. Admire the stunning sea views, savour delicious street food and soak up the lively atmosphere. With its Art Deco architecture, bustling crowds and breathtaking sunsets, Marine Drive is a must-visit spot in town.
IN.BOM.shoppingText:
Shopping in Mumbai caters to many tastes and budgets. Scout Fashion Street, a bustling marketplace bursting with clothes, accessories and footwear. It’s a go-to destination for budget-conscious fashion enthusiasts. Luxury brands and designer boutiques are also in abundance in Mumbai – make your way to South Mumbai for high-end fashion finds. 

Discover Zaveri Bazaar for a more opulent and classic Indian experience. The market is brimming with jewellery made of gold, silver and gemstones. Or uncover a world of spices, dried fruits and exotic teas in the traditional Crawford Market.
IN.BOM.destinationPageIntro: Experience the vibrant culture of Mumbai – explore the city’s museums, wander through its bustling markets or indulge in some spicy street food.
IN.BOM.overviewText:
Travel to Mumbai – formerly known as Bombay – and discover the vibrant heart of India. From bustling markets and ancient temples to towering skyscrapers and Bollywood glamour, Mumbai offers a captivating blend of tradition and modernity. Immerse yourself in the city’s rich history, explore its iconic landmarks and savour delectable flavours that Mumbai is known for.

With a flourishing cultural scene, there are plenty of museums, galleries and street festivals to enjoy amidst all the sightseeing. The city’s diversity ensures you’ll find your own unique experience, making Mumbai a memorable adventure filled with discovery.
IN.BOM.eatingImageText:
Begin your culinary journey with Mumbai’s renowned street food along Churchgate Station and Carter Road. Indulge in spicy treats such as a vada pav, a chilli potato fritter sandwich. Or a hearty plate of Bombay duck – which is actually a fish dish.

The fresh produce and atmosphere of Crawford Market is a must-do. It’s a great place to sample local snacks such as parathas (a staple flatbread), and chaat – crispy dough wafers served with chickpeas, potatoes and a tangy dressing.

Don’t miss out on ordering a Bombay Sandwich, made with a grilled mix of vegetables, chutney and spices. Mumbai’s café culture is also thriving, particularly in areas like Bandra and Colaba. Visit one of the cafés in these areas and order a steaming, hot cup of Indian chai for an authentic experience.

BR.GRU.overviewTabHeading: Book your visit to São Paulo
BR.GRU.businessClassSummary:
Fly to São Paulo in Business or First Class with Qatar Airways and land in Brazil’s thriving capital in style. From start to finish, every detail of your journey is crafted with care by our world-renowned team. 

Begin your trip with smooth priority check-in at a dedicated counter, followed by a peaceful break in one of our Business Class lounges. Nibble on refreshments, unwind in a quiet space, or take a revitalising shower before your departure. 

Once on board, our cabin crew welcome you to your spacious seat, featuring an ergonomic design and generous legroom. Thanks to ambient lighting, you can relax as your body adapts to your destination’s time zone. Connect to the high-speed Wi-Fi, available on our A380, A350, B787 and select B777 aircraft, to stay in touch with colleagues, friends and family. 

Indulge in gourmet cuisine whenever you prefer with Dine Anytime, and take your pick from an à la carte menu curated by award-winning chefs. Between meals, choose entertainment from our vast library of films, series and games. When you’re ready to rest, recline on a lie-flat bed with soft linen, then prepare for arrival using luxurious face and body care products from your amenity kit. 

Book a Business or First Class flight to São Paulo with Qatar Airways and experience unmatched comfort.
BR.GRU.touristAttractionsText:
Make your way to the Monasterio de São Bento, a site with beautiful gardens and architecture. The awe-inspiring Catedral da Sé located nearby beckons you to explore its Gothic spires, and soak in the grandeur of the city. 

Football fans, rejoice! There’s an entire museum dedicated to football. The Museu do Futebol walks you through the history of the sport in Brazil. 

Art enthusiasts, don’t skip the Pinacoteca do Estado de São Paulo – it’s the city’s oldest art museum and a cultural institution in Brazil, boasting the largest collection of Brazilian art. 

Go to Minhocão, a quirky elevated highway that turns into a pedestrian playground. Walk, skate or bike along this urban oasis dotted with colourful street art.

Spend the afternoon at Praça Por do Sol, a hilltop park that offers panoramic views of São Paulo and the best spot to watch the sunset.
BR.GRU.leisureActivitiesText:
Visit the Sala São Paulo to watch the São Paulo State Symphony Orchestra. Not only is the building an architectural marvel, but the ceiling adjusts to suit the orchestra’s sound to create stunning acoustics. It’s truly an awe-inspiring experience. 

Journey to Ibirapuera Park, where you can cycle along winding paths, admire the lakes, and uncover the lush flora. The park area is also home to world-class museums, a music hall and events like São Paulo Fashion Week.

If you plan to stay active during your visit, head to Parque da Juventude Dom Paulo Evaristo Arns. A former prison site, the space was transformed into a cultural park with sports facilities, a library and art installations to reinvent the collective memory of the area.

For a weekend trip out of the city, travel to Ilhabela Island. Whilst it’s a few hours from the city centre, this tropical paradise is worth the journey – with pristine beaches, waterfalls, and walking trails.
BR.GRU.businessClassTitle: Business Class flights to São Paulo
BR.GRU.shoppingText:
Benedito Calixto Market is an outdoor wonderland that springs to life every Saturday. Overflowing with vintage finds, handcrafted Amazonian arts and unique trinkets, you’ll be sure to take home a piece of Brazil’s heritage.

Stroll down Paulista Avenue, for chic and trendy boutiques. You can find everything from high end fashion to unique local designers.

For a taste of luxury, check out the Jardins district. Visit the shops along the leafy streets of Rua Oscar Freire, home to designer stores and upscale brands.

No shopping trip in São Paulo is complete without grabbing some local coffee as a souvenir so you can enjoy the rich aroma of Brazilian coffee beans at home.
BR.GRU.touristAttractionsTabHeading: Things to do in São Paulo
BR.GRU.destinationPageIntro: With a museum dedicated to soccer, vibrant streets and culinary delights, São Paulo has all the makings of a fantastic getaway.
BR.GRU.overviewText:
Discover the energy of the Brazilian city, São Paulo. Wander through its maze of vibrant streets where the hum of conversation, smell of fresh coffee, and rhythm of samba sweeps you off your feet. Every alleyway seems to reveal a surprise, from impromptu street performance showcasing São Paulo’s melting pot of cultures, to hidden quaint cafés. 

Explore São Paulo’s magnificent architecture, with modern skyscrapers sitting alongside historic monuments. 

It’s not all hustle and bustle though. São Paulo knows how to slow it down too, with luscious green spaces and its famous beaches not far from the city centre.
BR.GRU.eatingImageText:
Venture to the bustling Mercado Municipal where the air is thick with freshly caught seafood, exotic fruits, and aged cheeses. The legendary mortadella sandwich is the star of the show – a towering creation of meat stacked so high it’s a feast for both your eyes and taste buds.

The street food scene is strong in São Paulo. Meander down the city’s famous Paulista Avenue to sample the popular appetizer ‘coxinha’ – a deep fried teardrop shaped dough ball filled with creamy, shredded chicken. Follow that up with the much-loved dessert ‘churro’ – an indulgent deep fried choux pastry that’s powdered with sugar and accompanied with sweet sauces.

Complete your culinary expedition with the staple breakfast dish, pão na chapa – a slice of bread slathered with butter and grilled to perfection.

US.LAX.overviewTabHeading: Book your visit to Los Angeles
US.LAX.businessClassSummary:
Fly to Los Angeles in Business or First Class with Qatar Airways and immerse yourself in the glamour of luxury travel. Our world-renowned team takes care of your every need to bring you an expertly tailored experience.

Begin your journey with a smooth, stress-free check-in process, followed by a tranquil break in one of our exclusive Business Class lounges. Here, you can choose from an exceptional selection of drinks and snacks, use workstations to catch up on emails, or indulge in a hot shower while waiting for your flight.

On board our modern aircraft, you’re welcomed by a professional, courteous cabin crew and shown to your spacious seat. Stretch out in superior comfort thanks to extra legroom, or connect to the high-speed Wi-Fi (available on our A380, A350, B787 and select B777 aircraft) to stay in touch with colleagues or friends and family.

Dine on a variety of mouth-watering dishes from our à la carte menu, created by our award-winning chefs. Then sit back and watch a film or TV show from our vast entertainment library or get some rest on a lie-flat bed complete with soft linen. Ambient lighting gently synchronises your body to your destination’s time zone, so you arrive feeling revived and ready to relax in the Californian sunshine.

Book a flight to Los Angeles in Business or First Class with Qatar Airways and enjoy our renowned hospitality.
US.LAX.touristAttractionsText:
Stroll down the Hollywood Walk of Fame, where the star-studded sidewalks celebrate the legends of film, television, music and more. Visit the nearby Dolby Theatre on Hollywood Boulevard for a glimpse of where the stars gather each year for the Academy Awards.

For breathtaking landscapes, hike the Runyon Canyon loop. The trek rewards you with views overlooking the city and allows you to get up close to the Hollywood sign. Next, visit the Griffith Observatory for a view of the cosmos and maybe even a celebrity sighting.

A celebrity home tour through Beverly Hills and Bel-Air provides a sneak peek into the glamorous lives of Hollywood stars. If you’re interested in art, take a trip to the Getty Center to admire Van Gogh’s ‘Irises’.
US.LAX.leisureActivitiesText:
If you’re craving sunshine, visit Venice Beach and soak up the lively atmosphere of the boardwalk. Walk further down to the Santa Monica Pier for its famous Ferris wheel, stunning views of the Pacific Ocean and colourful eateries.

Alternatively, wander through the Venice Canals or take a coastal bike ride along The Strand, which stretches from Santa Monica to Manhattan Beach and finally ends at Torrance Beach.

The world-famous theme parks in Los Angele provide a great day out for the whole family, with a variety of rides and movie-themed attractions. In and around the parks, there’s also no shortage shopping and dining options.

Catch a baseball game at the Dodger Stadium or watch a concert at the Hollywood Bowl. There are endless possibilities for fun for all ages in Los Angeles.
US.LAX.businessClassTitle: Business Class flights to Los Angeles
US.LAX.shoppingText:
There’s a myriad of shopping areas in Los Angeles that suit all kinds of tastes and budgets. Head to the Fairfax District for boutiques and vintage stores. For a luxury shopping experience, head to the iconic Rodeo Drive - home to some of the world’s most prestigious fashion houses.

Melrose Place is another popular destination for boutique shopping, lined with designer stores, cafés and salons. Similarly, The Grove is a busy outdoor retail space for locals and tourists alike – it combines stores, dining and entertainment.

If you’re lucky enough to be in the city when the Rose Bowl Flea Market is on, you can discover a treasure trove of second-hand finds, antiques and unique collectibles just outside the city.
US.LAX.touristAttractionsTabHeading: Things to do in Los Angeles
US.LAX.destinationPageIntro: Los Angeles’ golden beaches, unmatched shopping and dining experiences will have you feeling like a Hollywood star.
US.LAX.overviewText:
Los Angeles is a place of exploration and adventure. It’s a vibrant hub of creativity, innovation and big aspirations. Nestled between the Pacific Ocean and the San Gabriel Mountains, it’s a beacon for those seeking entertainment and inspiration, with a thriving arts scene and the energy of countless cultures.

From the iconic neighbourhoods of Beverly Hills to the hip areas of Venice Beach, Los Angeles has something for everybody. Join the hype of this energetic city, relax on the mesmerising beaches or hike in the luscious mountainous region. Whether you’re drawn in by cultural richness, artistic innovation or natural splendour, Los Angeles promises an unforgettable experience.
US.LAX.destinationHighlightsH1: Los Angeles: The City of Angels
US.LAX.eatingImageText:
Savour flavours from around the world without leaving the city. Find everything from authentic Mexican tacos to freshly made sushi at the Grand Central Market – it’s a melting pot of global cuisines. For more multicultural indulgence, there’s Koreatown, Little Tokyo, and Little Tehran.

Visit the Santa Monica Farmers Market, not far from the city centre, where the city’s top chefs source their produce. The Original Farmers Market on the corner of 3rd and Fairfax is another one to frequent – it’s stocked with an array of local specialties and international foods.

Indulge in quintessential American cuisine with a juicy cheeseburger and fries. Los Angeles is also known for its health-conscious food – order a mouthwatering açaí bowl. Finally, try a California roll – a local sushi phenomenon.

GB.MAN.businessClassSummary:
Fly to Manchester in Business Class or First Class with Qatar Airways and arrive at one of the United Kingdom’s busiest cultural and commercial centres in style. Every detail is meticulously taken care of, with unrivalled service from our professional team who ensure that your journey is an absolute delight from start to finish.

Begin with quick and effortless check-in before unwinding in one of our exclusive Business Class lounges, while you wait to board the aircraft. Freshen up with an invigorating shower or find a quiet spot to log in and check your emails. As you scroll through them, sip on a cold beverage or relax with a good book until your flight is called.

When stepping onboard, you’re welcomed by our friendly cabin crew who show you to your seat. It’s ergonomically designed for maximum comfort with plenty of legroom. Once you’ve settled in, savour a delicious meal from our à la carte menu, followed by a movie from our entertainment variety. Or rest on a lie-flat bed while ambient lighting helps your body adjust to the local time zone. If work can't wait, connect to the super-fast Wi-Fi on our A380, A350, B787 and select B777 aircraft. 

Book a flight to Manchester in Business or First Class with Qatar Airways and enjoy luxury travel at its best.
GB.MAN.touristAttractionsText:
Football fans can tour Old Trafford, the iconic home of Manchester United. Immerse yourself in the club’s expansive history and experience the thrill of match day by catching a home game. Dive deeper into the football scene and visit the National Football Museum. 

If indulging in art is on your agenda, Manchester is bursting with art nooks and museums to marvel at. Wander through Whitworth, a gallery set in a park that integrates art, nature and architecture. Continue your exploration to the John Rylands Library and the Manchester Cathedral, both exquisite examples of classical building designs. 

For those with a curiosity for innovation, the Science and Industry Museum is a must-visit. Browse interactive exhibits that tell of Manchester’s role in the Industrial Revolution.
GB.MAN.leisureActivitiesText:
A dynamic hub of entertainment, Manchester offers endless excitement. Catch a world-class act at the Bridgewater Hall, sway to the beat of your favourite music artist at the AO Arena, or watch a theatre production at the Manchester Opera House. 

If you are travelling with the whole family, a day in LEGOLAND Discovery Centre is a great attraction for children and adults alike. 

When it’s time to explore the outdoors, take a walk within Greater Manchester’s lush parklands. Catch a tram and stroll through Heaton Park, one of the largest municipal parks in Europe.

Manchester serves as a gateway to North England. Take a scenic drive to the breathtaking Lake District – renowned for its stunning lakes, rugged mountains and dramatic valleys – and simply enjoy the tranquility of British nature.
GB.MAN.shoppingText:
Residents of Northern England flock to Manchester for its shopping. The city offers a blend of designer stores, unique boutiques and even vintage treasures.

Begin your shopping trip at Exchange Square and Market Street where you will find department stores and international brands.

For a more exclusive experience, head to King Street and Spinningfields where you can enjoy luxury venues and a sophisticated retail ambiance.

The Northern Quarter presents something different entirely, catering to vintage lovers with its myriad of second-hand stores.

If you’re looking for some unique souvenirs to take home, pick up some artisanal goods and handicraft from Church Street Market or Arndale Market. The Flower Market is also worth a visit to admire the stunning local blooms.
GB.MAN.destinationPageIntro: While a tour of Old Trafford is essential for “footy” fans, the Museum of Science and Industry and the intricate waterways of the Manchester Ship Canal will also swoon you.
GB.MAN.overviewText:
Manchester is teeming with culture, history and entertainment. Explore world-class museums and uncover a thriving arts community. You won’t be short of amusement in Manchester either – it’s home to giant arenas and concert halls that frequently host everything from concerts and festivals, to theatrical productions and comedy shows. Not to mention the legendary Manchester United and Manchester City football matches.

Beyond its attractions, Manchester has a diverse culinary scene, bustling markets, and incredible architecture. It’s an interesting destination to scout on foot, with hidden gems located all over the city. Whether you’re captivated by historic landmarks, mesmerised with cultural treasures, or passionate about sports – Manchester is a place that provides unforgettable travel memories.
GB.MAN.eatingImageText:
Manchester’s diverse culinary scene is showcased through its variety of gastropubs, cafés and restaurants. It is abundant with vegan and vegetarian eateries, halal venues, Michelin-star establishments and independent coffee shops.  

For a truly British experience, step into one of the city’s elegant tearooms for a taste of sandwiches, scones and pastries. Try an eccle’s cake, a sweet pastry filled with currants – one of the area’s finest baked good. 

Mosey through the Piccadilly Street Food Market and the Real Food Market. Find parched peas – black peas served with vinegar and salt, or a Manchester tart – a baked tart filled with jam and custard, topped with coconut and a cherry.

MY.KUL.overviewTabHeading: Book your visit to Kuala Lumpur
MY.KUL.businessClassSummary:
Fly to Kuala Lumpur in Business or First Class with Qatar Airways and arrive at one of the world’s busiest commercial centres feeling relaxed and ready to take on the city. From the moment you check in, our world-renowned team looks after your every need, making your experience memorable.

Begin by unwinding in one of our exclusive Business Class lounges. Take a hot shower, find a quiet place to work, easily check emails thanks to fast Wi-Fi, or sip a refreshing drink before you board the aircraft. When your flight is called, you’re welcomed by our courteous, professional cabin crew, who are dedicated to bringing you premium service throughout your journey. 

Sit back and enjoy the ergonomic seat and generous legroom that lets you stretch out in complete comfort. Ambient lighting helps your body adjust to your destination’s time zone, so you can settle in seamlessly. To savour irresistible flavour, tuck into a gourmet meal followed by a blockbuster film from our wide variety of entertainment options. Then drift off to sleep in a lie-flat bed and wake up well rested.  

Book a flight to Kuala Lumpur in Business or First Class with Qatar Airways and indulge in luxury travel.
MY.KUL.touristAttractionsText:
One of the top attractions in Kuala Lumpur is the Petronas Twin Towers. These dominate the skyline, and the observation deck is a panoramic marvel. If you thought those views were phenomenal, visit the Menara Kuala Lumpur – an architectural wonder, offering even more spectacular views across the city. 

Malaysia has a long history of metal crafting with pewter, which you can learn all about at the Royal Selangor Visitor Centre. Participate in a workshop to take home your own handmade piece of Kuala Lumpur’s heritage.

Interested in Kuala Lumpur’s spiritual side? Discover the tranquility of Thean Hou Temple and admire the intricate Chinese design. It’s also worth exploring the Batu Caves. These impressive limestone caverns are home to Hindu shrines and feature a humungous golden statue of Lord Murugan.
MY.KUL.leisureActivitiesText:
Stroll through the city’s diverse neighbourhoods for a glimpse of Kuala Lumpur’s history on foot. You will discover buildings from the colonial era, as well as incredible modern architecture. Look out for the Old Kuala Lumpur Railway Station – it is known as one of the most beautiful railway stations in the world.

Try your hand at Malaysia’s unique art form in a batik painting workshop and experience how this country’s rich artistic heritage continues to thrive in modern day Kuala Lumpur.

Take a quick break from the city at Bukit Gasing Forest Park. It’s filled with hiking trails and green spaces ideal for a recreational afternoon. The beauty of Kuala Lumpur’s skyline is best experienced in the early evening. Watch the sun set behind the Petronas Twin Towers from KLCC Park.
MY.KUL.businessClassTitle: Business Class flights to Kuala Lumpur
MY.KUL.shoppingText:
Shopping is one of the top things to do in Kuala Lumpur, with a variety of markets and premium shopping centres to roam.

Browse stores for luxury goods and designer brands at the many high-end malls dotted around the city.   

If you prefer to hunt for a bargain, embrace the buzzing atmosphere of Petaling Street. Here, you can pick up a souvenir to remember your travels, authentic pewter goods or sit and watch the world go by with a delicious bowl of Hokkien noodles.
MY.KUL.touristAttractionsTabHeading: Things to do in Kuala Lumpur
MY.KUL.destinationPageIntro: The dynamic city of Kuala Lumpur offers a wealth of experiences waiting to be explored from the top of the Petronas Twin Towers, to the majestic wonder of the Batu Caves.
MY.KUL.overviewText:
Kuala Lumpur is a bustling hub of culture, cuisine and shopping.

Discover iconic attractions, wander through enchanting gardens or immerse yourself in the liveliness of street markets.

With skyscrapers, historic landmarks, traditional shrines and lush greenery – this dynamic city blends modernity and tradition everywhere you look.
MY.KUL.destinationHighlightsH1: Kuala Lumpur: The vibrant heart of Malaysia
MY.KUL.eatingImageText:
Kuala Lumpur is bursting with places to relish quality, authentic food from the many ethnicities represented in the city.

Start your culinary journey at Lot 10 Hutong. This traditional Chinese food court is abundant with some of the best hawker foods, all under one roof. 

If you are interested in the street food scene, navigate through Jalan Alor night market and Petaling Street, filled with Malaysian delicacies such as laksa (spicy noodle dish), rendang (spicy meat dish) and the Indian flatbread roti canai. 

You cannot leave Malaysia without indulging in nasi lemak – Malaysia’s national dish. It consists of coconut rice served with spicy sambal (local chili sauce) and is typically eaten as a breakfast food; however, you can enjoy it at any time of day.

ID.CGK.businessClassSummary:
Fly to Jakarta in Business or First Class with Qatar Airways and embark on a seamless journey to one of Southeast Asia’s most dynamic capitals. From check-in to arrival, our dedicated team ensures a smooth travel experience tailored to your needs.

Your trip begins with priority check-in and swiftly passing through security. Unwind in one of our Business Class lounges, where you can sip on a cold beverage, nibble on a delightful snack, or use a private workstation to finalise plans before departure. You can also take a shower to freshen up before your flight is called.

Once on board, settle into your spacious seat with generous legroom, designed to bring you optimal comfort. Ambient lighting helps you adapt to a new time zone, while high-speed Wi-Fi lets you stay in touch with loved ones or handle urgent work on our A380, A350, B787 and select B777 aircraft.

Savour a gourmet dish from our à la carte menu, freshly prepared by our award-winning chefs, then watch a film or series from our extensive entertainment library. When it’s time to rest, enjoy a restorative sleep on a lie-flat bed with soft linen. You’ll land at your destination feeling revitalised and ready to explore thriving business and cultural scenes.
ID.CGK.touristAttractionsText:
Jakarta is known as the cultural hub of Indonesia – and for good reason. It’s bursting with cultural sites and noteworthy museums to visit.

The first stop on your itinerary is Monas – the National Monument. It’s a towering symbol of Indonesia’s independence which houses the National History Museum depicting the nation’s journey to freedom. Ascend to the top on a clear day for spectacular views of the city below.

Continue your cultural tour by delving into the city’s colonial past at the Jakarta History Museum. Then, admire the artistry and tradition of kites at the Kite Museum. If art is more your thing, visit the National Gallery, home to national and international pieces.

Last but not least is Taman Mini Indonesia Indah. This park showcases the heritage of Indonesia’s numerous regions with its display of traditional houses and artistic performances.
ID.CGK.leisureActivitiesText:
Jakarta is a lively city with plenty of activities for all kinds of travellers.

Merdeka Square is a good starting point, with the National Monument, pretty water features and sprawling green areas to explore.

Then, hire an old bicycle to travel through the quaint cobbled streets of Kota Tua, the historic Old Town. Ride to Sunda Kelapa Harbour, where traditional Indonesian Phinisi sailing boats are docked. Although this port serves as a domestic cargo hub today, it evokes the maritime spirit of Jakarta’s past.

Take a day to cruise the Thousand Islands, a serene archipelago set just off Jakarta’s coast. Similar to Bali, these islands offer pristine beaches, crystal-clear waters and thriving marine life.

If you are travelling with children, spend a day at Dunia Fantasi, Indonesia’s premier amusement park.
ID.CGK.shoppingText:
The city of Jakarta is renowned for its impressive array of malls, with upscale luxury boutiques alongside budget-friendly stores.

Jakarta’s two traditional markets, Pasar Baru and Tanah Abang, are lively hubs where you can immerse yourself in the local culture and dine on street food, while finding great textiles, clothing and various goods. Bring home Indonesian hand-dyed batik in the form of a scarf or use it for home décor.

Surabaya Street, otherwise known as Jalan Surabaya, is a haven for antique enthusiasts. This charming street is lined with stalls offering a treasure trove of antiques, from vintage cameras to colonial-era homeware. For a more multifaceted shopping experience, walk around Pasar Santa, a market filled with vintage finds and new goods.
ID.CGK.destinationPageIntro: Explore its many museums, taste Indonesian street food and delve into the city’s colonial past at historical sites. Travel to Jakarta for a trip like no other.
ID.CGK.overviewText:
Jakarta is a modern-day metropolis that’s also rich in cultural heritage.

As Indonesia’s bustling capital, Jakarta has a skyline of towering skyscrapers that contrast with historical landmarks. The streets are alive with constant movement and excitement, with plenty of hidden pockets of tranquility.

This city is a melting pot of ethnicities and cultures, reflected in its diverse culinary scene, vibrant festivals and eclectic arts.

Whether you’re exploring its luxurious malls, historical sites or local markets, Jakarta provides an exciting and varied experience for all types of travellers.
ID.CGK.eatingImageText:
Whether you are craving modern fusion or looking for classic Indonesian fare, Jakarta’s food scene is a gastronomic blend of flavours.

Scout Jalan Pasar Baru and Tanah Abang Market for traditional Indonesian cuisine. Enjoy a plate of nasi goreng – the country’s beloved fried rice or indulge in martabak – a sweet or savoury stuffed pancake. Kerak telor is another must-try dish made with glutinous rice, eggs and spices.

For a taste of authentic Indonesian-Chinese food, head to Glodok, Jakarta’s historical Chinatown. This marketplace is not only of cultural significance but is also one of the largest Chinatowns in the world. It’s famous for its iced coffee and is the only place you can find Rujak Shanghai Encim – a very rare salad of cuttlefish, greens and red sauce.

KR.ICN.touristAttractionsText:
Step back in time at Changdeokgung, a Joseon dynasty palace with majestic halls and grand architecture. The Secret Garden inside reveals lush greenery and ponds. Once frequented by royals of the past, they’re now an oasis in the heart of Seoul. However, Changdeokgung is just one of the Five Grand Palaces. Explore them all to learn more about Korea’s royal past. 

For a 360-degree view of the city, head to N Seoul Tower, perched at the top of Namsan Mountain. As you take in the breathtaking views, equally beautiful by day and night, don’t forget to leave your mark by adding a ‘lock of love’ to the tower’s fences.

Take a day trip from the city to the Korean Folk Village. This living museum presents a glimpse into Korean life during the Joseon dynasty, complete with costumed actors and traditional buildings.
KR.ICN.leisureActivitiesText:
Enjoy a short hike at the Naksan Section of the Seoul City Wall Trail. An ancient fortress wall, it stretches an impressive 18.6 kilometres in length and encircles the center of the city. While there, enjoy panoramic views of contemporary Seoul while admiring the rugged charm of stone battlements. All six sections of the trail narrate a different story, whether you are climbing forested hills or skirting urban landscapes.

Enjoy a slice of Korean life in Bukchon Hanok Village. Book a stay at a traditional Korean house, or hanok, where their wooden frames, tiled roofs and heated floors provide a perfect blend of heritage and comfort. Relax in a cosy room on floor beds, as you gaze out at a peaceful courtyard garden. A hanok is not just an accommodation, it’s a journey into the heart of Korean culture.
KR.ICN.shoppingText:
Hanbok is the traditional Korean dress. The intricacy of its elegant design with beautiful embroidery and colours is steeped in history. Purchase your own as a keepsake or opt to rent one at the many shops around Gyeongbokgung or Bukchon. Plus, you’ll be able to visit the major palaces for free if you’re wearing one!

Korea is famous for its skincare and Myeongdong’s streets are lined with stores that sell the best skincare and cosmetic brands the country has to offer. For high-end fashion and luxury shopping, head to Apgujeong in Gangnam. For more affordable high-street fashion, visit Hongdae, which is popular among students.
KR.ICN.destinationPageIntro: Experience South Korea through its capital, Seoul. It is an adventure for the senses with authentic cuisine, ancient palaces and breathtaking skyscrapers.
KR.ICN.overviewText:
The capital of South Korea, Seoul, is a city that is modern while deeply rooted in tradition. Its vibrant neighbourhoods offer a feast for the senses at every corner. Take in the aroma of street food, explore its busy streets lined with beauty stores and discover rich Korean culture and history. From traditional tea houses and bustling markets, to chic cafés and serene parks by the Han River, there’s something for every traveller.

Discover Seoul’s unique tapestry of activities, where each experience is an adventure. Whether you’re appreciating the rich flavours of local dishes or exploring the latest beauty trends, Seoul’s energy is truly infectious.
KR.ICN.destinationHighlightsH1: Seoul: A modern city steeped in tradition
KR.ICN.eatingImageText:
Wander through the streets of Insadong to discover tranquil tea houses. Visit Museum Kimchikan to learn about and sample some kimchi (spicy fermented napa cabbage) – the cornerstone of Korean cuisine. If you’re feeling less adventurous, try it in pancake form – kimchi jeon.

Head to Gwangjang or Namdaemun Market to discover the unique flavours of Korea. Give tteokbokki (spicy rice cakes) a try. The fiery kick of the sauce softened by rice cakes’ chewy texture is a dish loved by all ages. For a sweet treat, indulge in a bowl of bingsu – finely shaved ice, with sweet red beans or fruits. 

Don’t leave Seoul without trying Korean barbecue. Grill your meat of choice and enjoy it with the many free side dishes, or banchan, that you can refill to your heart’s content. It’s an unforgettable experience.

SA.JED.businessClassSummary:
Fly to Jeddah in Business or First Class with Qatar Airways and reach the Red Sea gateway in unmatched style. Your journey begins by checking in at a dedicated counter and taking a fast-tracked route through immigration, giving you ample time to relax before you fly. 

In one of our Business Class lounges, you can enjoy light dishes at any time, hop into the shower to feel refreshed, or make use of private work areas to stay productive. Prefer a breather? Find a comfortable armchair and take a moment to reset while waiting for your flight. 

Onboard, cutting-edge design features give you space to stretch out and settle into your seat. Highspeed WiFi on our A380, A350, B787 and select B777 aircraft, lets you connect with colleagues or family, while ambient lighting helps your body adjust naturally. Choose from an à la carte menu of freshly prepared dishes and a wide range of entertainment options, then convert your seat into a fully lie-flat bed for restorative sleep. Arrive at your destination ready for your meetings or next adventure.  

Book your Business or First Class flight to Jeddah with Qatar Airways and indulge in a luxurious travel experience.
SA.JED.touristAttractionsText:
Familiarise yourself with the history of Jeddah by exploring Old Jeddah (Al Balad). Beautifully preserved coral houses stand as a testament to traditional Arabian architecture. The intricate designs and unique materials used to build them offer a glimpse into the city’s plentiful past.

A trip to Jeddah wouldn’t be complete without a tour around its captivating mosques. These architectural gems stand as iconic landmarks, with some dating back 1,400 years.

Strolling around the city?

Be sure to catch a glimpse of the King Fahd Fountain – the world’s tallest – as its waters soar 312 metres into the air creating a mesmerising spectacle.

Explore more of the city’s cultural heritage by visiting the Tayebat Museum, showcasing historical architecture and artefacts.
SA.JED.leisureActivitiesText:
Take a leisurely stroll down the Jeddah Corniche. The waterfront promenade stretches along the Red Sea, providing spectacular sea views and public art installations to enjoy.

And as Jeddah is a coastal city, a visit to Al Saif beach is a must. The sunny coastline presents a great spot for sunbathing or unwinding by the sea.

Seeking a little more adventure? Go scuba diving and snorkelling in the Red Sea. The sea’s pristine waters make it the best destination to explore stunning marine life and coral reefs – so jump in! There’s plenty of tours available for both beginners and skilled divers. 

If you are travelling to Jeddah with the whole family, spend a day playing around Sail Island – a waterpark with swimming pools, water slides and attractions that will keep you cool.
SA.JED.shoppingText:
To witness the enchantment of a bustling souq, add Souq Al Alawi and Al Balad Market to your shopping destinations. These abundant marketplaces are treasure troves of Arabian trinkets, from handcrafted rugs to ceramics and aromatic spices. Gold is also a popular souvenir purchase, as well as oud (agarwood) and dates.

For a touch of glamour and luxury, wander down Jeddah Boulevard. Boasting upscale boutiques, art galleries and divine cafes, it’s a classic Middle Eastern experience to cherish.
SA.JED.destinationPageIntro: Explore a city bursting with energy and things to see and do. Tour the coral houses of Old Jeddah, explore Souq Al Alawi, or go scuba diving in the Red Sea.
SA.JED.overviewText:
The Saudi Arabian port city of Jeddah is a thriving metropolitan, deep-rooted in history, culture and spiritual significance. As the gateway to the holy city of Mecca, it is a vital hub for religious journeys within the region.

Beyond its spiritual significance, Jeddah boasts a blend of cultural richness and modern attractions. From its vibrant souqs and bustling streets, to its serene waterfront and majestic architecture, Jeddah offers all kinds of experiences that everyone can enjoy.
SA.JED.destinationHighlightsH1: Jeddah: Saudi Arabia’s thriving port city
SA.JED.eatingImageText:
The food scene in Jeddah is an appetising fusion of global and local flavours. With internationally renowned restaurants offering specialty dishes from across the world to eateries serving classical Saudi Arabian meals – you’ll be spoilt for choice.

Indulge in rich, local cuisine with a big bowl of kabsa. This fragrant and flavourful rice dish is cooked with meat, vegetables and a delightful blend of spices. It’s often served at family gatherings and celebrations, symbolising a meal of warmth and hospitality.

Make sure to order a traditional Saudi coffee on your travels, known as Qahwa. Unlike regular coffee, Qahwa is typically brewed with cardamom and served with dates. It’s a local custom to enjoy a coffee together.

US.IAD.businessClassSummary:
Fly to Washington in Business or First Class with Qatar Airways to explore iconic monuments or immerse yourself in the culture of this historic city. From the moment you begin your journey, our attentive team ensures a seamless experience combining comfort with world-class service.

Begin with swift check-in at a dedicated counter before unwinding in one of our exclusive Business Class lounges. Here, you can enjoy a light snack or sip a cool drink. To get through your to-do list, head to one of the private workstations, or freshen up with a shower while waiting for your flight.

On board, settle into a spacious seat with generous legroom. Connect to the high-speed Wi-Fi on our A380, A350, B787 and select B777 aircraft, making it easy to stay in touch or join an important meeting. Savour exquisite cuisine from our à la carte menu, with each dish crafted by award-winning chefs and served when you’re ready. When it’s time to rest, a lie-flat bed, soft linen and ambient lighting create a serene space for restorative sleep.

Book your Business or First Class flight to Washington with Qatar Airways today and travel in ultimate luxury.
US.IAD.touristAttractionsText:
In a city brimming with iconic landmarks and historical significance, there is no shortage of things to see. Visit the White House, the residence and workplace of the U.S. President.

From there, head to the National Mall, a landscaped park. Walk past the Lincoln Memorial, honouring Abraham Lincoln, the 16th President of the United States. Nearby, the World War II Memorial stands as a tribute to Americans who served during the war. At its centre, the Washington Monument rises high above the city, presenting panoramic views from the observation deck.

Explore Capitol Hill where the United States Capitol is located. This impressive dome houses the legislative branches of the U.S. Government and offers guided tours if you wish to learn more about the nation’s political history.
US.IAD.leisureActivitiesText:
Washington, D.C. is famous for its collection of 19 Smithsonian museums and galleries. From the awe-inspiring National Museum of American History to the fascinating National Air and Space Museum, there is something to captivate every visitor. There’s even a National Zoo, which is a popular attraction for families.

Visit the world’s first voice-activated museum, the Planet Word Museum, to explore the space of language and literacy through engaging and interactive exhibits.

Take a leisurely walk around the Tidal Basin. If you visit between the end of March and early April, you may see the cherry blossoms in bloom. Explore the Chesapeake and Ohio Canal for more walking trails and nature.

Immerse yourself in the jazz and blues scene, with numerous venues hosting live performances around the city.
US.IAD.shoppingText:
Washington, D.C. is known for its shopping almost as much as it is known for its political landmarks. CityCenterDC is a large development downtown, featuring high-end boutiques, designer stores and plenty of dining options.

Georgetown is the city’s oldest neighbourhood abundant with boutiques and well-known brands. Its historic influence provides an enjoyable shopping encounter, as you explore the cobblestone streets. Another shopping hotspot is 14th Street, where you can find a mix of eclectic boutiques and specialty stores.

For a traditional market experience, visit the Eastern Market. It sells an abundance of fresh produce, artisanal foods, handmade crafts and more.
US.IAD.destinationPageIntro: The White House, Lincoln Memorial, Washington Monument and Capitol Hill are just the prologue to your discovery of Washington, D.C.
US.IAD.overviewText:
Washington, D.C. is the political capital of the United States of America. It is home to significant landmarks and influential figures. The city has a strong historical heritage, with a huge variety of things to see and do. From world-class museums to spectacular buildings and natural wonders, you will always have something exciting to explore.

The diverse culinary scene is something to note, with local and international establishments sprawled across different neighbourhoods around the city.

Shopping in Washington, D.C. is worth bringing an empty suitcase for, with world-class malls and retail nooks all over the city. Enjoy an endless discovery of history, culture, character and charm.
US.IAD.destinationHighlightsH1: Washington, D.C.: Political capital of the USA
US.IAD.eatingImageText:
While the city boasts truly American attractions, the food in Washington D.C. is multicultural and dynamic. There are several notable restaurants near the National Mall while Georgetown is filled with charming eateries, upscale dining and cafés.

For a taste of local flavours, try the city’s famous mumbo sauce, a tangy and slightly sweet condiment that’s served with fried chicken or wings. Another Washington specialty is the half-smoke, a local-style hotdog served with chilli and cheese. There is a large cultural population in Washington, meaning you’ll find a variety of flavourful dishes everywhere – make sure to try some Salvadorian and Ethiopian specialties.

For classic dining, the steak houses are top-notch and are typically frequented by politicians in the area.

KE.NBO.businessClassSummary:
Fly to Nairobi in Business or First Class with Qatar Airways and embark on an exceptional journey to one of Africa’s most exciting capitals. During every moment, our world-renowned team ensures a flawless experience tailored to your needs. 

Your trip begins with priority check-in and a swift, hassle-free passage through immigration. Then, spend some time in one of our premium Business Class lounges, where you can sip a cold beverage or tuck into a delicious snack. Make use of a private workstation for checking your emails or take a shower so you can freshen up while waiting for your flight to be called. 

Once on board, settle into your ergonomically designed seat with generous legroom, bringing you optimal comfort. Ambient lighting helps you adapt to your destination’s time zone, while high-speed Wi-Fi (available on our A380, A350, B787 and select B777 aircraft) lets you stay in touch with loved ones or take part in a video meeting.  

Savour a gourmet dish from our à la carte menu, freshly prepared by our award-winning chefs, before watching a film or TV series from our extensive entertainment library. When it’s time to rest, relax on a lie-flat bed with soft bed linen for a restorative sleep. You’ll land at your destination feeling revitalised and ready to explore the city’s thriving business and cultural scenes.  

Book a Business or First Class flight to Nairobi with Qatar Airways and enjoy the ultimate in luxury travel.
KE.NBO.touristAttractionsText:
If you’re visiting Nairobi for its stunning wildlife and incredible nature experiences, then you’re in for a treat. Kick off your Kenyan adventure at Nairobi National Park, a unique sanctuary where you can marvel at the Big Five – lions, leopards, rhinoceros, elephants and buffalos.

Discover the history of Nairobi at the National Museum, home to an extensive collection of artefacts that tell the story of the nation’s heritage. Don’t miss the Karen Blixen Museum – once home to the well-known author of ‘Out of Africa’, it offers a glimpse into Blixen’s life in the Kenyan countryside.

Experience Kenya’s cultural diversity at the Bomas of Kenya, a vibrant centre that comes alive with traditional dance, music and crafts from various communities.
KE.NBO.leisureActivitiesText:
What’s a trip to Nairobi without a wild animal encounter? Stop by Giraffe Centre – just a short drive from the city centre – for an unforgettable experience with the endangered Rothschild giraffes. You can feed these gentle giants and maybe even get a nose nuzzle!

A visit to the renowned elephant nursery of David Sheldrick Wildlife Trust is another must-do. You can book a time to join the orphaned elephants at their midday mud baths and bottle feeds, while gaining insight into the trust’s conservation efforts.

Make sure to explore Karura Forest – its lush greenery, waterfalls and serene atmosphere make it the perfect urban sanctuary within the city. If you’re up for a day trip, head to Oloolua Nature Trail, just outside the city, and hike through its indigenous forests along a scenic river.
KE.NBO.shoppingText:
Begin your shopping adventure at the Village Market, where you can find fashion, jewellery and home décor crafted by local artisans.

Wander along Ngong Road, a popular spot for tourists, and explore a wide array of handmade homewares. You can shop for exquisite pottery, woven baskets, and other artisanal treasures that reflect the rich cultural heritage of the region.

Visit Maasai Market for souvenirs from the Maasai people, including beautiful beadwork, intricate masks and other crafts. For a taste of shopping that is quite bespoke, head to Kitengela Glass – a studio famous for its recycled art, with detailed glass sculptures and tableware.
KE.NBO.destinationPageIntro: Enjoy the relaxed café culture in Nairobi, then head off for a spectacular safari at Nairobi National Park where you can try to spot one of the Big Five.
KE.NBO.overviewText:
Nairobi is a city frequented for its natural beauty and wildlife. It also surprises visitors with its welcoming, urban vibrancy. From June to October, the dry season’s clear skies and warm weather create the perfect conditions for wildlife viewing and outdoor adventure. The city boasts an abundance of lush landscapes and astonishing African wildlife, with national parks, reserves and even city parks.

A lively cultural hotspot, Nairobi pulses with a rich blend of history, traditions and art. Dive into the city’s vibrant local customs and savour some speciality cuisine to truly experience its charming character. Whether you’re seeking adventure, relaxation, or cultural immersion, Nairobi promises an unforgettable journey.
KE.NBO.destinationHighlightsH1: Nairobi: The safari capital of Kenya
KE.NBO.eatingImageText:
Sample Kenyan street food in the Maasai Market, where you can try ugali, a maize flour staple often served alongside savoury stews.

Meat lovers should head to Kenyatta Market to taste some of the town’s best nyama choma, a tantalising grilled meat dish. Another must-try is irio, a traditional Kikuyu dish made from mashed potatoes, peas and corn, often paired with nyama choma.

If you’re craving variety, Nairobi also offers a delightful range of international cuisine options, from Indian to Italian and more.

VN.SGN.overviewTabHeading: Book your visit to Ho Chi Minh City
VN.SGN.touristAttractionsText:
A post office may be a strange tourist attraction, but Saigon Central Post Office is an exception. This incredible French Colonial building from the 19th century is an ornate combination of European and Asian design.

A visit to Ho Chi Minh City Museum lets you explore the culture and history of the city and the president after whom the city is named. Or visit the Museum of Vietnamese History before taking a stroll around the botanical gardens. If you’re here with the children, don’t miss the hilarious water puppet show.

Ho Chi Minh City is full of temples, and you can visit the city’s oldest, the Giac Lam Pagoda. Dating back to the 18th century and surrounded by gardens, it’s a peaceful escape from the hustle and bustle of the city.
VN.SGN.leisureactivitiesTabHeading: Activities in Ho Chi Minh City
VN.SGN.leisureActivitiesText:
It can get hot in Ho Chi Minh City, so cool off with a family day out at the city’s water park, with slides, pools and even the odd animatronic dinosaur or two to make you jump.

Shows and entertainment keep everyone amused in the city, from water puppets to traditional music and dance. Take in a show and learn more about Vietnamese culture.

For a change of pace, take a day trip beyond the city limits with a boat trip along the Mekong Delta. You can combine this with a shopping expedition as you can browse some of the floating markets, filled with fresh produce and locally made goods.

If you’d rather stay local to the city centre, embark on a Saigon River boat cruise at sunset, or take a boat ride to the Phu Chau Floating Temple. The tranquillity and peace is a serene escape and a chance to relax.
VN.SGN.shoppingText:
Ho Chi Minh City’s blend of contemporary and traditional infrastructure translates to its shopping scene. Start your shopping at the Ben Thanh Market, a central marketplace selling everything from fresh produce to handcrafted souvenirs and clothing.

Walk down Nguyen Hue Street, a lively shopping and entertainment zone with boutiques, flagship stores, and street performers. Here, you can find high-end fashion, electronics, and bespoke gifts. For book lovers, Nguyen Van Binh Book Street is a haven of bookstores and cafes.

An Dong Market is a treasure trove of fabrics and exquisite textiles. You can scout delicate silks, detailed embroidery, and even have a suit custom-made by one of the city’s talented tailors.
VN.SGN.touristAttractionsTabHeading: Things to do in Ho Chi Minh City
VN.SGN.destinationPageIntro: Visit Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam's southern gem, to wander through old marketplaces such as Ben Thanh, and indulge in a delicious bowl of authentic pho.
VN.SGN.overviewText:
Ho Chi Minh City pulses with energy and is full of truly memorable experiences for adventurous travellers. The blend of 21st century skyscrapers and colonial architecture highlights the city’s evolution through different eras.

Its energetic street atmosphere offers a sensory feast, with delicious Vietnamese cuisine and bustling marketplaces to explore.

Saigon, as it’s also known, is a bustling, vibrant city where tradition meets modern life and where each district has its own distinct personality. Shopping ranges from markets to malls, and the food is quite simply delicious. From historic alleys to contemporary art venues and serene temples, Ho Chi Minh City is a place of old and new, with a new experience waiting to delight you around every corner.
VN.SGN.socialProofQuote: Book flights to Ho Chi Minh City (SGN)
VN.SGN.shoppingTabHeading: Shopping in Ho Chi Minh City
VN.SGN.eatingTabHeading: Food in Ho Chi Minh City
VN.SGN.destinationHighlightsH1: Ho Chi Minh City: Vietnam’s vibrant heart
VN.SGN.eatingImageText:
Vietnam is famous for its food, with its unique dishes and recipes enjoyed all over the world. Begin your gastronomic journey with pho, a Vietnamese noodle soup made with your choice of meat in a rich, aromatic broth flavoured with herbs and spices.

The soup differs depending on the region, and you’ll find pho in Ho Chi Minh City slightly sweeter than elsewhere. For a light lunch, indulge in bun cha, a bowl of grilled patties and noodles, with crisp herbs and tangy dipping sauce.

The street food in Ho Chi Minh City is unparalleled, much like many other areas of Southeast Asia. Stroll through markets and streets vendors dotted around the city for snacks of banh mi and rice paper rolls.

If you are looking for alternate cuisines, try Little Tokyo’s intimate eateries for delicious Japanese fare.

US.MIA.businessClassSummary:
Fly to Miami in Business or First Class with Qatar Airways and bask in the pleasures of luxury travel. From the moment you arrive at the airport, our world-renowned team are on hand to ensure every part of your journey is memorable.

Start with a smooth, hassle-free check-in process, before spending some time in one of our exclusive Business Class lounges. Here, you can sip a cool beverage, savour a light snack, use the workstations to catch up on emails, or take a rejuvenating shower before your flight.

On board our spacious aircraft, our dedicated cabin crew show you to your seat. Stretch out in optimal comfort thanks to its ergonomic design and additional legroom, while ambient lighting helps your body adjust to your destination’s time zone. Stable, high-speed Wi-Fi (available on our A380, A350, B787 and select B777 aircraft) lets you connect to that important video call or stay in touch with family and friends.

During the flight, delight your taste buds with a selection of mouth-watering dishes from our à la carte menu, prepared by our award-winning chefs. Then enjoy a film, game or TV show from our vast entertainment library, or drift into a sound sleep on a lie-flat bed, complete with soft linen. Land at your destination revived and ready to do business.

Book a Business or First Class flight to Miami with Qatar Airways today for a world-class experience.
US.MIA.touristAttractionsText:
Relax on South Beach, where the atmosphere is upbeat and the waves are rolling. Swim in the blue waters, laze on the white sands or book a sun lounger for maximum comfort. 

Take a stroll along Ocean Drive and enjoy the Art Deco Historic District – a living museum of 1930s architecture that brings retro glamour to life. 

For a touch of old-world elegance, visit the Vizcaya Museum and Gardens, a stunning estate with Renaissance-influenced architecture. For more serene scenes, make your way to Bayfront Park for views of Biscayne Bay, events, and scenic walks – it’s a hub for recreation.

If you’re wondering how to get around, hop on the Miami Trolley to explore the city’s diverse neighbourhoods and attractions with ease. Travelling down the bustling streets on this quirky tram to see the sights is an adventure in itself.
US.MIA.leisureActivitiesText:
Explore the Phillip and Patricia Frost Museum of Science, for interactive technology and weather exhibits, a planetarium and even an aquarium – all under the one roof.

If you’re visiting with little ones, the Miami Zoo is always a good idea. This sprawling sanctuary provides close-up encounters with exotic animals in naturalistic habitats.

For a wild escape, venture out of the city to the Everglades National Park. This vast wilderness is brimming with wildlife such as alligators, crocodiles and manatees. Embark on an airboat tour to experience the iconic Florida wetlands from a unique perspective.
US.MIA.shoppingText:
Discover a mix of shops and boutiques at Bayside Marketplace, while enjoying live music and a view across the marina. Browse items with a Miami flair, from souvenirs and local goods, to beachwear fashion and homeware.

The Miami Design District is a treasure trove of high-end boutiques, cutting-edge galleries and designer showrooms. Whether you’re on the hunt for the best runway looks or an exclusive designer handbag, prepare for a shopping spree you’ll never forget.

Lincoln Road’s open-air promenade is both stylish and relaxed. The street is lined with luxury brands alongside eclectic boutiques. Find a trendy swimsuit or summer outfit that captures Miami’s chilled yet glamorous vibe.
US.MIA.destinationPageIntro: Gators roam exotic swamps while celebrities bask on white sand beaches. Miami is a hot spot in more ways than one.
US.MIA.overviewText:
Stroll along the sun-kissed streets of Miami, where the ocean breeze instantly relaxes you and the rhythmic hum of Latin beats can be heard at every corner. Enjoy the fusion of cultures, with hidden cafés and international restaurants, colourful street murals, lively markets and events happening both day and night. 

Embrace Miami’s dynamic energy, where tropical beauty meets urban chic in one beachside city. Whether you’re lounging on pristine beaches, exploring natural wonders or enjoying the rhythm of the city’s atmosphere – you won’t want to leave this Floridian hot spot.
US.MIA.destinationHighlightsH1: Miami: A city of sunshine and excitement
US.MIA.eatingImageText:
Miami’s culinary scene is a vibrant blend of flavours. Little Havana is a prime example, where authentic Cuban cuisine can be found at the centre of Miami. Enjoy Cuban coffee with the sound of salsa music in the background. Or try mouthwatering ropa vieja (stewed beef and tomatoes) and tostones (crispy, fried plantains).

Head over to Wynwood, where the Wynwood Walls provide an incredible backdrop to a dining experience like no other. This artistic neighbourhood is a hot spot for Latin-inspired dishes, with trendy eateries serving spicy tacos and ceviche, a dish of fresh fish marinated in citrus.

For a laidback vibe, Coconut Grove is filled with charming cafés and waterside restaurants where you can indulge in freshly caught local seafood.

CH.ZRH.businessClassSummary:
Book a flight to Zurich in Business or First Class with Qatar Airways and head to one of the world’s financial capitals in unmatched luxury. There’s no better way to travel, as our world-renowned team makes every element of your journey memorable. 

Begin with smooth, stress-free check-in at a dedicated counter, before relaxing in one of our Business Class lounges. In these serene spaces, you can freshen up with an invigorating shower while waiting to board. You can also read a good book as you sip a revitalising beverage or check your emails in peace and quiet. 

When your flight is called, you're welcomed onboard our modern aircraft by professional cabin crew, committed to making your trip as comfortable as possible from start to finish. Settle into a spacious, ergonomically designed seat with extra legroom and join that critical video meeting. Connect to the fast Wi-Fi, available on our A380, A350, B787 and select B777 aircraft, and enjoy uninterrupted access throughout your flight.  

After the call, dine on freshly prepared à la carte cuisine, created by our team of award-winning chefs. Once you’ve satisfied your taste buds, watch a film from our vast selection of entertainment options. Then enjoy a restful sleep on a lie-flat bed, so you arrive feeling refreshed and ready to do business or explore cultural charms.
CH.ZRH.touristAttractionsText:
